sa: तस्य दर्शनजः शोकः सुतस्याप्रतिकर्मणः॥ उच्छोषयति वै प्राणान् वारि स्तोकमिवातपः।
en: Even as the sun dried up a drop of water, grief for not seeing my son of incomparable acts dried my spirits.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीदिदम्। एष पन्था मयोद्दिष्टो येन यान्ति महर्षयः॥
en: Thus addressed by Rāma, Viśvāmitra replied. Even this path has been fixed upon by men, that, namely, by which the Maharșis go.

sa: एवमुक्तो नृपतिनां रामो धर्मभृतां वरः। प्रत्युवाचाञ्जलिं कृत्वा पितरं वाक्यकोविदः॥
en: Thus addressed by the monarch, Rāma, the best of the righteous, well versed in speech, with joined hands addressed his father thus.

sa: ईदृशे वर्तमाने तु तूर्योद्धृष्टनिनादिते। विरग्नि ते परिक्रम्य ऊहुर्भार्या महौजसः॥
en: To the blowing of trumpets, those exceedingly puissant ones, thrice going round the fire, in company with their wives went the encampment.

sa: ततः स्वलंकृतं राजा नगरं प्रविवेश ह॥ शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिहादैः पुरस्कृत्वा द्विजर्षभम्।
en: Then the monarch, preceded by the foremost of Brāhmanas before him, entered the decorated city, to the blares of conches and drums.

sa: ततः पुरुषसिंहानां वृतानां तैः सुद्गणैः। शोचतामेव रजनी दुःखेन व्यत्यवर्तत॥ रजन्यां सुप्रभातायां भ्रातरस्ते सुहृद्वताः। मन्दाकिन्यां हुतं जप्यं कृत्वा राममुपागमन्॥
en: As those foremost of persons surrounded by their friends indulged in lamentations, the night passed away in grief. On the night being succeeded by an auspicious morning, those brothers surrounded by their friends, having performed Homa and Japa on the Mandākinī, returned to Rāma.

sa: इयं गिरिगुहा रम्या विशाला युक्तमारुता॥ अस्यां वत्स्याम सौमित्रे वर्षरात्रमरिंदम।
en: O Saumitri, O slayer of foes, in this pleasant and spacious mountain cave filled with air, we shall pass the rainy season.

sa: ततः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा वै नागरा द्विजम् ॥ प्रवेश्यमानं सत्कृत्य नरेन्द्रणेन्द्रकर्मणा। यथा दिवि सुरेन्द्रेण सहस्राक्षेण काश्यपम्॥
en: And beholding that Brāhmaṇa entering the city, duly honoured by the prime of men; subservient to Indra, like to Kaśyapa's son entering the celestial regions honoured of the thousand eyed lord of the celestials, all the citizens rejoiced exceedingly.

sa: तं दीनमानसं दीनमासेदुर्मृगपक्षिणः॥ सव्यं कृत्वा महात्मानं घोरांश्च ससृजुः स्वरान्।
en: And birds and beasts approached that highsouled one distressed and depressed in spirit; and staying on his left set up frightful cries.

sa: इत्येवमुक्ता जटिला चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरा। अनुज्ञाता तु रामेण हुत्वाऽऽत्मानं हुताशने ॥ ज्वलत्पावकसंकाशा स्वर्गमेव जगाम ह। दिव्याभरणसंयुक्ता दिव्यमाल्यानुलेपना ॥ दिव्याम्बरधरा तत्र बभूव प्रियदर्शना। विराजयन्ती तं देशं विद्युत्सौदामनी यथा॥
en: Being thus addressed and ordered by Rāma, Savarī, wearing matted locks, rags and the skin of an antelope, surrendered herself to fire and rose high up in the welkin like to blazing fire. Adorned with celestial ornaments, wreathed with celestial garlands, sprinkled with sandal-paste and wearing celestial cloth she appeared of exquisite grace and lighted up the quarters like to lightning.

sa: तदेवं शक्तियुक्तस्य पूर्वं प्रतिकृतस्तथा। रामस्यार्हसि पिङ्गेश कर्तुं सर्वात्मना प्रियम्॥
en: O lord of monkeys, it therefore behoveth you to do good by all means to the powerful Rāma, who benefited you before.

sa: चतुरङ्गबलं चापि शीघ्रं निर्यातु सर्वशः। ममाज्ञासमकालं च यानं युग्यमनुत्तमम्॥
en: And let the fore-fold forces sally out with speed. And at my command let horses and conveyances and elegant vehicles march out

sa: एवं दशरथः प्रीतो ब्राह्मणा नैगमास्तथा॥ रामस्य शीलवृत्तेन सर्वे विषयवासिनः।
en: Dasaratha was exceedingly delighted; as also the Brahmanas, and the traders, and the inhabitants generally, at the conduct and behaviour of Rāma.

sa: स चोद्धृतेन बाणेन सहसा स्वर्गमास्थितः। भगवन्तावुभौ शोचन्नन्धाविति विलप्य च॥
en: And as soon as the arrow had been extracted, he ascended heaven, O reverend sir, lamenting and bewailing you, both grown old.

sa: स तेन परमास्त्रेण मानवेन समाहतः। सम्पूर्ण योजनशतं क्षिप्तः सागरसम्प्लवे॥
en: And wounded by that foremost of Mānava weapons, Mārīca carried off a sheer hundred Yojanas, dropped in the midst of the ocean.

sa: इदं शरीरं कृत्स्नस्य लोकस्य चरता हितम्। पाण्डुरस्यातपत्रस्यच्छायायां जरितं मया॥
en: And under the shade of the white umbrella, I effecting the good of the entire community, have brought decrepitude upon my body.

sa: प्राप्नुवन्त्ययशश्चैव धर्मभ्रंशं च मैथिलि। अकार्यवशमापन्नाः स्त्रियो याः खलु तद्विधाः॥
en: O Mithilā's daughter, surely women of this sort who are given to doing evil acts, reap infamy and fall off from righteousness.

sa: इत्युक्तस्तु तया राम वसिष्ठस्तु महायशाः। सृजस्वेति तदोवाच बलं परबलार्दनम्॥
en: Thus accosted by her, the highly famous Vasistha, O Rama, said, 'Create you forces capable of crushing the forces of the enemy.'

sa: अभ्यवर्तत पुष्पाणां धारा वैश्रवणानुजम्। नक्षत्रमाला विमला मेरुं नगमिवोत्तमम् ॥
en: And the showers of blossoms scattered around Vaisravana's younger brother, looked like rows of burning stars round the foremost of mountains*. Sumerus

sa: औपवाह्यं रथं युक्त्वा त्वमायाहि हयोत्तमैः। प्रापयैनं महाभागमितो जनपदात् परम्॥
en: Yoking a riding car with excellent horses, do you come hither; and take the exalted one to the south of the kingdom.

sa: सबाष्पकलया वाचा कलहंसस्वरो युवा। विललाप सभामध्ये जगहें च पुरोहितम्॥
en: Then in words choked with the melodious voice of a swan, lamented and taxed the priest, in the midst of the assembly.

sa: उद्यानानि परित्यज्य क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च। एकदुःखसुखा राममनुगच्छाम धार्मिकम्॥
en: And leaving aside our gardens and fields and abodes, will we, making the righteous Rāma's happiness and misery our own, follow him.

sa: एतौ तौ सम्प्रकाशेते गोत्रवन्तौ मनोरमौ। वायुवेगसमौ वीरौ जवनौ तुरगोत्तमौ॥
en: There are seen these graceful and well-bred steeds, courageous, swift, and furnished with the speed of the wind, the best of horses.

sa: अथ त्रिवेणुसम्पन्नं कामगं पावकार्चिषम्। मणिसोपानचित्राङ्गं बभञ्ज च महारथम्॥ पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतीकाशं छत्रं च व्यजनैः सह। पातयामास वेगेन ग्राहिभी राक्षसैः सह ॥ सारथेश्चास्य वेगेन तुण्डेन च महच्छिरः। पुनर्व्यपहनच्छ्रीमान् पक्षिराजो महाबलः॥
en: Next crumbling into pieces with his impetus the mighty chariot of Rāvana, coursing at will, flaming like fire having steps studded with jewels, and a wooden pole, and throwing down the umbrella and chowris like to the full moon along with the Rākşasas engaged in carrying them, the effulgent and mighty lord of birds shattered the head of the charioteer with the strokes of his beak.

sa: तं प्रेक्ष्य भरतः क्रुद्धं शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रवीत्। अवध्याः सर्वभूतानां प्रमदाः क्षम्यतामिति॥
en: Thereupon casting his eyes on Satrughna, Bharata said, “A woman is incapable of being slain by any. Do you therefore excuse her.”

sa: दृष्ट्वा रामं चाक्लिष्टकारिणम्। आगमिष्यामि ते वक्त्रं सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते॥
en: Or having seen Mithila's daughter, as well as Rāma of untiring deeds, I will enter your mouth. This I promise you truly."

sa: सारसारावसंनादैः सारसारावनादिनी। याऽऽश्रमे रमते बाला साद्य मे रमते कथम्॥
en: How shall that Sarasa-voiced damsel be pleased to-day, who, while sporting in the hermitage, used to warble like Sārasas, to invite them.

sa: उदधृत्य तैलसंसेकात् स तु भूमौ निवेशितम्। आपीतवर्णवदनं प्रसुप्तमिव भूमिपम्॥ संवेश्य शयने चाग्र्ये नानारत्नपरिष्कृते। ततो दशरथं पुत्रो विललाप सुदुःखितः॥
en: And raising from under the oil the body of the king with a sallow countenance, and appearing to be asleep. Bharata placed it on the ground upon a couch in front adorned with various gems. Then overwhelmed with grief, Dasaratha's son bewailed him thus.

sa: तं रथं राजपुत्राय सूतः कनकभूषितम्। आचचक्षेऽञ्जलिं कृत्वा युक्तं परमवाजिभिः॥
en: Then the charioteer with joined hands announced to the prince that the car adorned with gold was ready, yoked with excellent horses.

sa: सागरः समयं कृत्वा न वेलामतिवर्तते। समयं मानृतं कार्षीः पर्ववृत्तमनुस्मरन्।॥
en: And the ocean, having bound himself by promise, never passes beyond his shores. Remembering these old stories render not your promise nugatory.

sa: स्वयमेव हि धर्मात्मा प्रयातो मुनिशासनात्। सुमन्त्रस्त्वरितो भूत्वा समानेतुं महामतिः॥
en: The virtuous Sumantra, in accordance with the injunction of the ascetic, himself speedily set out for the purpose of bringing the monarchs.

sa: तं तोलयित्वा बाहुभ्यां गतसत्त्वमचेतनम्। चिक्षेप वेगवान् वाली वेगेनैकेन योजनम्॥
en: And taking up with his arms that lifeless one, the mighty Vāli hurled him with great force at distance of a Yojana.

sa: पाण्डुरेण तु शैलेन परिक्षिप्तं दुरासदम्। वानरेन्द्रगृहं रम्यं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्॥ शुक्लैः प्रासादशिखरैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्॥ महेन्द्रदत्तैः श्रीमद्भिर्नीलजीमूतसंनिभैः। दिव्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैः शीतच्छायैर्मनोरमैः॥ हरिभिः संवृतद्वारं बलिभिः शस्त्रपाणिभिः। दिव्यमाल्यावृतं शुभ्रं तप्तकाञ्चनतोरणम्॥ सुग्रीवस्य गृहं रम्यं प्रविवेश महाबलः। अवार्यमाणः सौमित्रिर्महाभ्रमिव भास्करः॥
en: Unobstructed the highly powerful Saumitri entered the picturesque abode of Sugrīva like to the Sun entering into a collection of dense clouds. The abode of this lord of monkeys was like to the palace of the Lord of celestials, ornamented with the tops of white buildings resembling the summits of the Kailasa hill and flowery trees producing at all times, wished-for fruits, covered with beautiful trees having cool shades and bearing celestial fruits and flowers resembling the molten-god.

sa: आत्मानमनुशोच त्वं किमन्यमनुशोचसि। आयुस्तु हीयते यस्य स्थितस्यास्य गतस्य च॥
en: Do you therefore deplore yourself. Why do you lament any thing else? Every one's life is decreasing, whether he sits or moves.

sa: एकाहमपि पश्येयं यद्यहं राममातरम्। अञ्जलिं प्रतिगृह्णन्ती श्रेयो ननु मृतिर्मम॥
en: If I for a single day behold Rāma's mother receiving homage rendered with clasped hands, I will consider death even as welcome.

sa: तथेति च स राजानमुवाच द्विजसत्तमः। भविष्यन्ति सुता राजश्चत्वारस्ते कुलोद्वहाः॥
en: Thereupon the best of Brāhmaṇas told the king that he would have four sons, born to him, as perpetuators of his race.

sa: ते सरांसि सरित्कक्षानाकाशं नगराणि च। नदीदुर्गास्तथा देशान् विचिन्वन्ति समन्ततः॥
en: And on all sides they explore watery expanses, and streams, and lawns, and commons, and cities, and tracts rendered impassable by torrents.

sa: तव प्रसादान्मुक्तोऽहमभिशापात् सुदारुणात्॥ भुवनं स्वं गमिष्यामि स्वस्ति वोऽस्तु परंतप।
en: Through your grace have I been freed from this fearful curse, I shall (now) repair to heaven. Hail, O repressor of foes!

sa: कृतवानसि यत् कर्म श्रुतवानस्मि भार्गव । अनुरुध्यामहे ब्रह्मन् पितुरानृण्यमास्थितः॥
en: O Bhrgu's son, I have heard of the deeds you have performed, resolved on avenging your sire. O Brāhmaṇa, I acknowledge that.

sa: स तमाश्रममागम्य भरद्वाजस्य वीर्यवान्। अवतीर्य रथात् पादौ ववन्दे कुलनन्दनः॥
en: Approaching the asylum, the puissant Bharata descended from the car, and the son of Raghu then paid homage to the saint's feet.

sa: वसिष्ठो वामदेवश्च जाबालिश्च दृढव्रतः। अग्रतः प्रययुः सर्वे मन्त्रिणो मन्त्रपूजिताः॥
en: And Vasiştha, and Vāmadeva and Jāvāli steady his vow as well as the minister, honoured on account of their counsels, went before.

sa: उक्तवाक्यं तु राजानं कृपया कुशिकात्मजः। अब्रवीन्मधुरं वाक्यं साक्षाच्चण्डालतां गतम्॥
en: When the king had spoken thus, Kausika's son, moved with pity, said these sweet words to the king who had undergone Candāla-hood.

sa: एकपुत्रा च साध्वी च विवत्सेयं त्वया कृता। तस्मात् त्वं सततं दुःखं प्रेत्य चेह च लप्स्यसे ॥
en: Chaste and having an only son, that lady has through you been separated from her son, (like a cow separated from her calf). For this, you will always have to suffer misery alike in this world and the next.

sa: मुमुदे मुदितो लोकस्तेन तोयेन भास्वता॥ कृताभिषेको गङ्गायां बभूव गतकल्मषः।
en: And through the agency of that shining water, all beings, feeling delight, rejoiced, and having bathed in Gangā, became cleansed from sin.

sa: दहन्ति सर्वभूतानि त्वत्तो निष्क्रम्य हेतयः। जातवेदस्त्वयैवेदं विश्वं सृष्टं महाद्युते॥
en: O effulgent deity, this universe is created by you. The Vedas are your words; all creatures, mobile and immobile, depend upon you.

sa: परं चाभिप्रयातस्य चक्रं तस्य महात्मनः। भविष्यत्यप्रतिहतं सततं चक्रवर्तिनः :॥
en: When that illustrious king of kings (your son) will march out against his foes, his army will be irresistible to all opposition.

sa: संछन्नः स तु वासोभिर्जीवन्निव नराधिपः। शुशुभे स नरव्याघ्रो महार्हशयनोचितः॥
en: With the new dress on, the king appeared like a living man, as if he was only sleeping on a costly bed.

sa: स भवान्विस्तरेणेमां पुनराख्यातुमर्हति। न हि तृष्यामि पूर्वेषां शृण्वानश्चरितं महत्॥
en: You should, therefore, recite it in full. I am not satisfied with hearing in the abstract this great history of my ancestors.

sa: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः। उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सहस्राक्षं पुरंदरम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the deities, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, said with folded hands to Purandara, of a thousand eyes:

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणं काकुत्स्थः परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत्। मा विषादं कृथाः शूर नैतत्क्षत्रियचेष्टितम्॥
en: He having said this, Rāma embraced him and said: Be not sorry O hero. This is not a becoming action for Kşatriyas.

sa: अनुक्रोशात्मतां तस्य शमीकस्यावधार्य च। पर्यतप्यत भूयोऽपि कृत्वा तत्किल्बिषं मुनेः॥
en: Seeing also the great kindness shown to him by the Rishi and recollecting his own great act, the king became very penitent.

sa: तांस्तथावादिनः पौरान् दुःखितान् दुःखकर्शितः। उवाच मनसा ध्यात्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The king of virtue, Yudhisthira reflected for some time and then addressed in sorrow the citizens who were talking thus in grief.

sa: दशरात्रोषितानां तु तत्र तेषां पुरोचनः। निवेदयामास गृहं शिवाख्यमशिवं तदा॥
en: When they had lived there for ten nights, Purochana spoke to them about the house, called "Blessed,” though really (it was) unblessed.

sa: शृणुमः किमिदं स्वप्ने गीतबन्धनमुत्तमम्। विस्मयं ते परं गत्वा शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रुवन्॥
en: What wonder, that in a dream we hear such an excellent song. Being in this wise greatly surprised they said to Satrughna.

sa: राजपुत्रस्तु कौरव्य पाण्डुर्मूलफलाशनः। जगाम सह पत्नीभ्यां ततो नागशतं गिरिम्॥
en: The descendant of Kuru, the royal prince (Pandu), living on fruits and roots went with his two wives to the Nagashata mountains.

sa: स हि तान् याजयामास सर्वान् नृपतिसत्तमान्। ब्रह्मर्षिः पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ बृहस्पतिरिवामरान्॥
en: Therefore, seek to appoint as your priest an accomplished Brahmana in whose heart virtue predominates and who is learned in the Vedas.

sa: मुनि विरजसं द्रष्टुं गमिष्यामि तपोधनम्। काश्यपं स्थीयतामत्र यावदागमनं मम॥
en: “I shall go to see the mighty ascetic, the son of Kashyapa, who is free from Rajoguna. Stay here till I return."

sa: पुत्राश्च भ्रातरश्चेमे शिष्याश्च सुहृदश्च वः। पाण्डवा एत इत्युक्त्वा मुनयोन्तर्हितास्ततः॥
en: "Our these pupils," said they, “Are your sons, your brothers and your friends. They are the Pandavas.” So saying they went away.

sa: यथासमयमाज्ञाय तदा स नृपसत्तमः। द्वाभ्यामेकं फलं प्रादात् पत्नीभ्यां भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, recollecting his former promise, that best of kings gave that one fruit to his two wives.

sa: ततो भीमस्तदा नागैः कृतस्वस्त्ययनः शुचिः। प्राङ्मुखश्चोपविष्टश्च रसं पिबति पाण्डवः॥
en: Thereupon, purifying himself carefully, the Pandava Bhima sat facing the east and began to drink the Rasa. The Nagas performed auspicious rites.

sa: तस्मिंस्तथाविधे काले वर्तमाने सुदारुणे। नावश्यायः पपातोल् ततः सम्यानि नारुहन्॥
en: During that terrible season (of draught) not even a drop of dew fell on the earth and (consequently) no corn was grown.

sa: नृपति त्वभ्यनुज्ञाप्य वसिष्ठोऽथापचक्रमे। सोऽथ राजा गिरौ तस्मिन् विजहारामरो यथा॥
en: Then bidding farewell to the king, Vasishtha left him and went away. Thereupon, the king sported on that mountain like a celestials.

sa: उष्णमश्रु विमुञ्चन्तस्तं विहाय महीपतिम्। ययुर्नागपुरं तूर्णं सर्वमादाय तद् धनम्॥
en: They shed hot tears to leave the king. They left that forest and went to Hastinapur, taking all the wealth with them.

sa: सपुत्रा त्वं प्रसादं नः कर्तुमर्हसि शोभने। पुनर्दृष्टिप्रदानेन राज्ञः संत्रातुमर्हसि॥
en: O handsome lady, you with your son should show mercy on us. You should favour these kings by granting them their sight.”

sa: एवं स कथयन्नेव निद्रया जनमेजय। कौन्तेयोऽपि हृतस्तस्मिन् शयने स्वर्गसंनिभे॥
en: O Janamejaya, when he was thus talking as he lay. on the celestials-like bed, sleep (slowly) stole on the son of Kunti.

sa: कृष्णस्य भवने रम्ये रत्नभोज्यसमावृते। उवास सह कृष्णेन बहुलास्तत्र शर्वरीः॥
en: In the delightful mansion of Krishna, adorned with gems and filled with every article of enjoyment, he passed many nights with Krishna.

sa: पुरा देवयुगे ब्रह्म प्रजापतिसुते शुभे। आस्तां भगिन्यौ रूपेण समुपेतेद्धतेऽनघ॥
en: O Brahmana, in the golden age Prajapati had two fair daughters. O sinless one, the two sisters were endued with great beauty.

sa: तत्र दानं ददुर्वीरा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सहस्रशः। भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकाश्चैव महे तस्य गिरेस्तदा।॥
en: In that mountain-festival of the Bhoja, the Andhakas and the Vrishnis, the hero gave away much wealth to the thousands of Brahmanas.

sa: रक्ष्यमाणो महाभूतैः सिद्धेश्च परमर्षिभिः। उवास स महाराज समेषु विषमेषु च॥ इन्द्रद्युम्नसरः प्राप्य हंसकूटमतीत्य च। शतशृङ्गे महाराज तापस: समतप्यत॥
en: Protected by Mahabhutas, Siddhas and great Rishis, that great king lived sometimes on the plain and sometimes on the hills. He then went to the lake Indradyumna; and then crossing the Hansakuta, the great king performed his penances on the mountain with hundred peaks.

sa: सर्व एव समागम्य शतक्रुतमथाब्रुवन्। कालस्ते विक्रमस्याद्य जहि शत्रून् पुरन्दर॥
en: They all assembled together and thus spoke to Indra. “O Indra, the time has come to show your prowess. Kill your enemies."

sa: स किरातैश्च चीनैश्च वृतः प्राग्ज्योतिषोऽ ऽभवत्। अन्यैश्च बहुभिर्योधैः सागरानूपवासिभिः॥
en: The king of Pragjyotisha was supported by hosts of Kiratas and Chins and by numerous other warriors that dwelt on the sea-coast.

sa: उवाच चैनं कल्याण्या वाचा मधुरयोत्थितम्। मा भर्मनुजशार्दूल भद्रमस्तु तवानघ॥
en: He spoke to him these words, both sweet and beneficial, “O best of men, do not fear, O sinless one,, be blessed."

sa: तामन्वेष्टुं स नृपतिः परिचक्राम सर्वतः। वनं वनजपत्राक्षीं भ्रमन्नुन्मत्तवत् तदा।॥
en: The king then, like one who has loss his reason, wandered through the whole forest in search of that lotus eyed maiden.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्य शौचेन प्रीताः प्रकृतयोऽभवन्। धृत्या च भीमसेनस्य विक्रमेणार्जुनस्य च॥
en: The chief men of the city were highly pleased with the purity of Yudhishthira, the strength of Bhima, the gallantry of Arjuna.

sa: गुरुशुश्रूषया क्षान्त्या यमयोविनयेन च। तुतोष लोकः सकलस्तेषां शौर्यगुणेन च॥
en: The obedience to all their superiors, patience and the humility of Nakula and Sahadeva. All people were rejoiced to see their heroism.

sa: ततोऽम्बिकायां प्रथमं नियुक्तः सत्यवागृषिः। दीप्यमानेषु दीपेषु शरणं प्रविवेश ह॥
en: Then the truthful Rishi, who had given his promise as regards Ambika first, came to her bed-room while the lamp was burning.

sa: स मृताश्वश्चरन् पार्थ पद्भ्यामेव गिरौ नृपः। ददर्शासदृशीं लोके कन्यामायतलोचनाम्॥
en: O Partha, abandoning the dead horse, the king walked on the mountain and saw a maiden of large eyes and matchless beauty.

sa: ततस्तिलोत्तमा तत्र बने पुष्पाणि चिन्वती। वेशं साऽऽक्षिप्तमाधाय रक्तेनैकेन वाससा॥
en: Thereupon Tilottama, attired in a single red silk cloth and thereby exposing all her charms, came there gathering flowers in the forest.

sa: इति रोषवशावुभौ तदानीमन्योन्यं शपितौ नृपद्विजेन्द्रौ। सहसैव बभूवतुर्विदेही तत्तुल्याधिगतप्रभाववन्तौ ॥
en: That king and the ascetic having thus imprecated one another under the influence of anger, they immediately were deprived of their bodies.

sa: स्तनं तु दक्षिणं भित्त्वा ब्रह्मणो नरविग्रहः। निसृतो भगवान्धर्मः सर्वलोकसुखावहः॥
en: The illustrious Dharma, the dispenser of all happiness, came out of the right breast of Brahma, assuming the form of a man.

sa: सुबद्धस्यापि भारस्य पूर्वबन्धः श्लथायते॥ तथा बहुविधं कृष्णां विलपन्ती धनंजयः सान्त्वयामास भूयश्च क्षमयामास चासकृत्॥ सुभद्रां त्वरमाणश्च रक्तकौशेयवासिनीम्। पार्थः प्रस्थापयामास कृत्वा गोपालिकावपुः॥ साधिकं तेन रूपेण शोभमाना यशस्विनी।
en: A second always relaxes the first one, however strong it might be.” Thus Krishna (Draupadi) lamented in various strains and Dhananjaya (Arjuna) comforted her, asking again and again her forgiveness. Coming to Subhadra attired in red silk, Partha sent her (into the inner apartments) dressed in the grab of a cow-herd women. The illustrious lady looked handsome even in that dress.

sa: ततो वनस्थे पितरि मात्रोश्चैव विशाम्पते। जरासंध स्ववीर्येण पार्थिवानकरोद् वशे॥
en: O king, after his father and mother had retired into the forest, Jarasandha brought numerous kings under his sway by his velour.

sa: कल्माषपादं राजर्षिमशपद् ब्राह्मणी रुषा। यस्मान्ममाकृतार्थायास्त्वया क्षुद्र नृशंसवत्॥ प्रेक्षन्त्या भक्षितो मेऽद्य प्रियो भर्ता महायशाः। तस्मात् त्वमपि दुर्बुद्धे मच्छापपरिविक्षतः॥ पत्नीमृतावनुप्राप्य सद्यस्त्यक्ष्यसि जीवितम्। यस्य चर्षेर्वसिष्ठस्य त्वया पुत्रा विनाशिताः॥
en: The Brahmani cursed the royal sage Kalmashapada in anger. “O wretch, because you have to day cruelly devoured in my very sight my illustrious and beloved husband when I was not gratified, therefore you shall by my curse meet with an instant death when you will unite yourself with your wife in season. That Rishi Vasishtha, whose son you have devoured,

sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सौमित्रिस्त्वरयान्वितः। न्यवेदयत रामाय तापसं तं समागतम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the great saint, Saumitri speedily went to Råghava and communicated to him the arrival of the ascetic, saying.

sa: तत्र तत्र च युद्धानि राजपुत्रैरमर्षणैः। चित्राङ्गदाया: पुत्रेण पुत्रिकाया धनंजयः॥
en: And his fight with various chiefs and potentates who seized it in wrath, the encounter of Arjuna with the son of Chitrangada.

sa: तं प्रीयमाणो गोविन्दो विनयेनाभिपूजयन्। भीमं च पुरुषव्याघ्रं विधिवत् प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: Being much pleased with the reception, Govinda (Krishna) worshipped him (Yudhishthira) with all humility. He duly worshipped that best of men Bhima.

sa: श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं सर्वं विस्तरेण तपोधन। तेषां चेष्टितमन्योन्यं युक्तानां कृष्णया सह॥
en: O ascetic Rishi, I desire to hear everything in detail as regards their conduct towards one another after their union with Krishna.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ताः प्रयातास्ते पाण्डवा जनमेजय। राज्ञा दक्षिणपञ्चालान् दुपदेनाभिरक्षितान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : OJanamejaya, having been thus addressed, the Pandavas proceeded towards the Southern Panchala country, uled over by the king Drupada.

sa: सोऽवनिं मध्यामां भुक्त्वा मिथोभेदममन्यत। प्रभुर्यस्तु परो राजा यस्मिन्नेकवशे जगत्॥ स साम्राज्यं महाराज प्राप्तो भवति योगतः। तं स राजा जरासंधं संश्रित्य किल सर्वशः॥ राजन् सेनापतिर्जातः शिशुपालः प्रतापवान्। तमेव च महाराज शिष्यवत् समुपस्थितः॥ वक्रः करूषाधिपतिर्मायायोधी महाबलः। अपरौ च महावीरों महात्मानौ समाश्रितौ॥
en: Enjoying the sovereignty of the middle portion of thirteenth, he tried to create disunion among ourselves. O great-king, the monarch, who is the lord of all kings and whose sway extends over the whole earth, is the proper person to be an Emperor. O king, the powerful Shisupala having every way placed himself under his protection, has become his commander-in-chief. great king, the powerful king of the Karushas, Vakra, who fight with the power of illusion, also waits upon him as his disciple. The two other greatly powerful and illustrious monarchs have taken the protection.

sa: ततो दुर्योधन: क्रूरः कर्णश्च सह सौबलः। तेषां निग्रहनिर्वासान्विविधांस्ते समारभन्॥
en: Thereupon, the wicked-minded Duryodhana, with Karna and the son of Subala, (Shakuni), tried to banish them and persecuted them in various ways.

sa: संजय उवाच श्रुतवानसि वै राजन्महोत्साहान्महाबलान्॥ द्वैपायनस्य वदतो नारदस्य च धीमतः। महत्सु राजवंशेषु गुणैः समुदितेषु च॥ जातान्दिव्यास्त्रविदुषः शक्रप्रतिमतेजसः। धर्मेण पृथिवीं जित्वा यज्ञैरिष्ट्वाप्तदक्षिणैः॥ अस्मिल्लोके यशः प्राप्य ततः कालवशं गतान्।
en: Sanjaya said : From wise Narada and Vyasa you have heard, O king, of immensely powerful men, men of great exertions, men born of great royal dynasties, men full of great qualities, men wellversed in the art of using celestial weapons, men who, having conquered the world by righteous war and perforining sacrifices with proper offerings, obtained fame in this world and finally succumbed to death.

sa: प्रमाणकोट्यां संसुप्तं पुनर्बध्वा वृकोदरम्। तोयेषु भीमं गङ्गायाः प्रक्षिप्य पुरमाव्रजत्॥
en: That wretch one day bound the sleeping Bhima on the bank of the Ganges and throwing him into the water, went away.

sa: प्रोवाच चामितमतिः प्रश्रितं विनयान्वितः। द्रुपदं पाण्डुपुत्राणां संनिधौ केशवस्य च॥
en: The immeasurably intelligent Vidura then, in the presence of the Pandavas and Keshava (Krishna), thus modestly addressed Drupada in words of affection.

sa: ततो राजा परिक्रम्य यथाकामं यथासुखम्। निवृत्तौऽन्तःपुरं पार्थ प्रविवेश महात्मनाः॥
en: O Partha, that high-minded king, after roaming at pleasure and at will (for sometime), returned (to his palace) and entered the innerapartment.

sa: देवयान्यथ भूयोऽपि पितरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। पुष्पाहारः प्रेषणकृत् कचस्तात न दृश्यते॥
en: Devayani again spoke to her father thus, "O father, Kacha was sent to gather flowers, but he is not to be seen.

sa: कुमारोऽयं वसुर्नाम स चेहाद्याभिषिच्यताम्। श्वभ्रं च यत्सुखस्पर्श क्रियतां शिल्पिभिर्मम।।।।।
en: Do you therefore even today, place the prince Vasu on the throne, and let the architects prepare ap leasant den for me.

sa: इला सा सोमपुत्रस्य संवत्सरमथोषिता। अकरोत्कि नरश्रेष्ठ तत्त्वं शंसितुमर्हसि ॥
en: O foremost of men, tell us what did Ila afterwards do after living in the company of Soma's son for a year.

sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शून्ये स्वजनवर्जिते। इला सुरुचिरप्रख्यं प्रत्युवाच महाप्रभम्॥
en: Hearing the words of the highly effulgent and beautiful Budha in the picturesque forest land divested of men and animals, Ila said.

sa: तान् गृहीतशरावापान् क्रुद्धानापततो बहून्। द्रुपदो वीक्ष्य संत्रासाद् ब्राह्मणाञ्छरणं गतः॥
en: Seeing those kings all rushing upon him in anger with bows and arrows, Drupada sought the protection of the Brahmanas from fear.

sa: सौतिरुवाच श्रुत्वा तमब्रुवन्सर्पा आहरामृतमोजसा। ततो दास्याद्विप्रमोक्षो भविता तव खेचर॥
en: Sauti said: Having heard him the snakes said, “Bring the Ambrosia by force. Then, O bird, you will be freed from slavery."

sa: वृषपर्वणो राजपेस्ततोऽभिगमनं स्मृतम्। आर्टिषेणाश्रमे चैषां गमनं वास एव च॥
en: The meeting (of the Pandavas) with the Royal sage Vrishaparva; their departure for the hermitage of Arshtishena and then their stay there;

sa: अथापरं महेष्वासं सत्यवत्यां सुतं प्रभुः। विचित्रवीर्यं राजानं जनयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: The powerful king begot on Satyavati another son, named Vichitravirya, who became a mighty bow-man; and he became king after his father.

sa: यथाहमभिजानीयां ब्राह्मणं लक्षणैः शुभैः। तन्मे कारणतो मातः पृच्छतो वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: O mother, you should tell me, who ask you, the auspicious indications by which I shall be able to recognise a Brahmana.

sa: तस्मिन् गते महाभागे लपितां प्रति भारत॥ अपत्यस्नेहसंयुक्ता जरिता बह्वचिन्तयत्।
en: O descendant of Bharata, when the illustrious Rishi went away to Lapita. Jarita, filled with affection for her offspring, became very thoughtful.

sa: भयं तु ते व्येतु विषादमोही त्यजाशु चैवेन्द्रसमप्रभाव। त्वां वर्तमानं हि सतां सकाशे नालं प्रसोढुं बलहापि शक्रः॥
en: O Indra-like great one, let your fears be dispelled, let your woes and afflictions cease. । You are now in the presence of the virtuous and the wise. Even Indra, the slayer of Bala, cannot do you any harm.

sa: निविष्टे तत्र कौन्तेये ब्राह्मणेषु च भारत। अग्निहोत्राणि विप्रास्ते प्रादुश्चक्रुनेकशः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, when the son of Kunti (Arjuna) and the Brahmanas lived there the letter performed many Agnihotras (fire sacrifices).

sa: ताभ्यां च यत्र स मुनिौवनं प्रतिपादितः। मांधातुश्चाप्युपाख्यानं राज्ञोऽत्रैव प्रकीर्तितम्॥
en: And in which it has been shown how he himself (Chyavana) acquired perpetual youth. Then it relates the history of King Mandhata;

sa: आरण्यकं च वेदेभ्य ओषधिभ्योऽमृतं यथा। ह्रदानामुदधिः श्रेष्ठो गौर्वरिष्ठा चतुष्पदाम्॥
en: As Aranyaka among the Vedas, as ambrosia among medicines, as the ocean is great among all lakes, as cow among all quadrupeds.

sa: प्रेष्यतां द्रुपदायाशु नरः कश्चित् प्रियंवदः। बहुलं रत्नमादाय तेषामर्थाय भारत।॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, send a sweetspeeched man to Drupada; let him carry for them (the Pandavas) a large treasure with him.

sa: अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सुसंपन्ना महात्मनः। स राज्यं तादृशं भुङ्क्ते स्फीतमद्भुतदर्शनम्॥
en: Without being cultivated earth used to yield crops. In this wise for many long years he governed a prosperous and wonderful kingdom.

sa: स कलिङ्गानतिक्रम्य देशानायतनानि च। हाणि रमणीयानि प्रेक्षमाणो ययौ प्रभुः॥
en: Crossing (the country of the Kalingas and seeing on his way many countries, holy places and charming mansions, that lord preceded on.

sa: पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा विनिश्चित्य महामतिः। विवेश वैष्णवं तेजः सशरीरः सहानुजः॥
en: Hearing the words of the Patriarch and determining everything the high-minded Rāma entered there bodily with his brothers in his Visnu form.

sa: चरता धर्मनित्येन वनवासं यशस्विना। नष्टः पैतामहो वंशः पाण्डुना पुनरुद्धृतः॥
en: The almost extinct race of his forefathers was thus revived by the illustrious Pandu, leading in piety the life of a recluse.

sa: लालप्यमानं तमृषि मन्दपालं तथा वने। लपिता प्रत्युवाचेदं सासूयमिव भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, when the Rishi Mandapala was thus lamenting in the forest, Lapita, out of jealousy, thus replied to him,

sa: शान्तनुश्चापि शोकार्तो जगाम स्वपुरं ततः। तस्याहं कीर्तयिष्यामि शान्तनोरधिकान् गुणान्॥
en: Shantanu then went to his own capital with a sorrowful heart. I shall now narrate to you the many accomplishments of Shantanu,

sa: गृहीत्वा हरणं प्राप्ते कृष्णे देवकिनन्दने। अभिमन्योः सुभद्रायां जन्म चोत्तमतेजसः॥
en: Taking the dower of Krishna, Arjuna's departure to Indraprastha; the birth of that prodigy of prowess, Abhimanyu, in the womb of Subhadra;

sa: एष हि प्रज्वलन्नग्निर्लेलिहानो महीरुहान्। आविग्ने हृदि संतापं जनयत्यशिवं मम॥
en: This blazing fire that licks up the trees produces sorrow in my anxious heart; it create in my mind anticipations of fear.

sa: क्षत्तुश्च धार्तराष्ट्रेण प्रेषणं पाण्डवान्प्रति। विदुरस्य च संप्राप्तिदर्शनं केशवस्य च॥
en: The sending of Vidura as an envoy to the Pandavas from the sons of Dhritarashtra; his arrival; and his meeting with Krishna;

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच समुच्छ्रयं देवयानीं गतां सक्तां च वाससि॥ शर्मिष्ठा प्राक्षिपत् कूपे ततः स्वपुरमागमत्। हतेयमिति विज्ञाय शर्मिष्ठा पापनिश्चया॥ अनवेक्ष्य ययौ वेश्म क्रोधवेगपरायणा। अथ तं देशमभ्यागाद् ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard this, Devayani became very angry and she began to tear her cloth. But Sharmishtha, throwing her into a well, went away to her home. The wicked Sharmishtha thought her to be dead and went home in a wrathful mood. When she went away, the son of Nahusha, Yayati came to that place; he was after deer.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तु कृतदारेभ्यः पाण्डुभ्यः प्राहिणोद्वरिः। वैदूर्यमणिचित्राणि हैमान्याभरणानि च॥
en: Vaishampayana said : After the Pandavas had been married, Hari (Krishna) sent them various golden ornaments set with pearls and Vaidurya gems.

sa: करग्रहणपूर्वं तु कृत्वा पादाभिवन्दनम्। कक्षैः कक्षां विधुन्वानावास्फोटं तत्र चक्रतुः॥
en: Seizing each other's arms and twining each other's legs, they slapped their arm-pits. They caused the arena to tremble with that sounds.

sa: पाहि मां भगवन् पापादस्माद् दारुणदर्शनात्। राक्षसोऽयमिहात्तुं वै नूनमावां समीहते॥
en: O illustrious Sir, save me from this cruel wretch of fearful appearance. The Rakshasas is certainly coming towards us to devour us.

sa: न निवर्तेत् पुनर्जीवन् कश्चिदन्यो ममोदरात्। ब्राह्मणं वर्जयित्वैकं तस्माद् विद्यामवाप्नुहि॥
en: come None can out alive from my stomach. A Brahmana, however, must not be killed. Therefore, accept the knowledge I teach you.

sa: तत्र ह्येवं भवितारो न संशयो योनि सर्वे मानुषीमाविशध्वम्। तत्र यूयं कर्म कृत्वाविषह्यं बहूनन्यान् निधनं प्रापयित्वा॥ आगन्तारः पुनरेवेन्द्रलोकं स्वकर्मणा पूर्वजितं महार्हम्। सर्वं मया भाषितमेतदेवं कर्तव्यमन्यद् विविधार्थयुक्तम्॥
en: The fate of you all should certainly by the same. All of you shall have to take births in the world of men, where having achieved many difficult feats and killing large number of men, you shall again regain the valued region of Indra by the merits of your respective deeds. You shall accomplish all I have said and much more.

sa: त्रितयं सर्वथाप्येवं विनशिष्यत्यसंशयम्। त्वया विहीनं तस्मात् त्वं मां परित्यक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: There is no doubt the three (myself, our son and daughter) will all die without you. Therefore you ought to abandon me.

sa: ज्ञेयं विवादपर्वात्र कर्णस्यापि महात्मनः। निर्याणं च ततः पर्व कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः॥
en: Then comes the quarrel of the noble Karna, then the march of the Kuru and Pandava armies to the field of battle.

sa: नारद उवाच सभा वैश्रवणी राजञ्छतयोजनमायता। विस्तीर्णा सप्ततिश्चैव योजनानि सितप्रभा॥
en: Narada said O king, the greatly effulgent assembly-hall of Vaishravana (Kubera) is one hundreds Yojanas in length and seventy Yojanas in breadth.

sa: राजा कल्माषपादोऽयं वीर्यवान् प्रथितो भुवि। स एषोऽस्मिन् वनोद्देशे निवसत्यतिभीषणः॥
en: He is the king Kalmashapada celebrated in the world as being a very powerful (monarch). That fearful man lives in this forest.

sa: यत्तेभिलषितं प्राप्तुं फलं तस्मान्नृपोत्तमात्। अहमेव प्रदास्यामि तत्ते यद्यपि दुर्लभम्॥
en: I shall give you the wealth you hope to get from the best of kings, however difficult may it be get it.

sa: यः पाण्डुं धृतरा च विदुरं चाप्यजीजनत्। शान्तनो: संततिं तन्वन्पुण्यकीर्तिर्महायशाः॥
en: That great Rishi of sacred deeds and great fame, in order to continue the line of Shantanu begot Pandu, Dhritarashtra and Vidura.

sa: आमन्त्र्य तु सहस्राक्षं प्रायात्किचिदवाङ्मुखः। पुनरेवागमच्छीमानिमं लोकं नरेश्वरः॥ स कृत्वा हृदयेऽमर्ष सभृत्यबलवाहनः। आजगाम मधोः पुत्रं वशे कर्तुमरिंदमः॥
en: Thereupon, having welcomed Indra in that way, he left there and returned earth. O slayer of enemies, with an angry heart, army and conveyance he went to subjugate Madhu's son Lavaņa and sent an emissary inviting him to battle.

sa: तत्रागच्छन्ति राजानः पृथिव्यां नृपसंज्ञिताः। बहूनि रत्नान्यादाय आगमिष्यति ते पिता॥
en: At that time, all great kings of carth will arrive there. Your father too will come there with many gems (for gift).

sa: अथ द्रोण: कुमारांस्तान् दृष्ट्वा कृत्यवतस्तदा। प्रहस्य मन्दं पैशल्यादभ्यभाषत वीर्यवान्॥
en: The powerful Drona, seeing the princes unsuccessful in their attempts, smiled a little and being conscious of his own skill, he said-

sa: मत्स्यांस्त्रिगर्तान् पञ्चालान् कीचकानन्तरेण च। रमणीयान् वनोद्देशान् प्रेक्षमाणाः सरांसि च॥
en: The countries of the Matsyas, Trigartas and Panchalas, then to that of the Kichakas, where they saw mane beautiful woods and lakes.

sa: साहाय्येऽस्मि स्थितः पार्थ पातयिष्यामि राक्षसम्। नकुलः सहदेवश्च मातरं गोपयिष्यतः॥
en: O son of Pritha, I stand here to help you. I shall kill the Rakshasas. Nakula and Sahadeva will protect our mother.

sa: अथान्योन्यं समाश्लिष्य विकर्षन्तौ पुनः पुनः। दावाग्निधूमसदृशं चक्रतुः पार्थिवं रजः॥
en: They clasped and pressed each other again and again. The dust of the earth rose like the smoke of the forest fire.

sa: न्यवेदयंस्तत् पुरुषा धात्रराष्ट्राय वै तदा। ततो दुर्योधनस्तत्र पाण्डवानाह दुर्मतिः॥
en: When all was ready, they gave information to the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana.) Thereupon the wicked minded Duryodhana said to the Pandavas.

sa: अथ छित्त्वा नदी पाशांस्तस्यारिबलसूदन। स्थलस्थं तमृषि कृत्वा विपाशं समवासृजत्॥
en: O chastiser of hostile ranks, the river, having torn those cords and making him free of them, cast him on the land.

sa: अग्नेस्तु जातः स मुनिस्ततो भरतसत्तम। भारद्वाजं तदाग्नेयं महास्त्रं प्रत्यपादयत्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the Rishi, born of fire, gave that great fire, weapon to the son of Bharadvaja (Drona).

sa: ततो दुर्योधनः कर्णमालम्ब्यागकरे नृपः। दीपिकाग्निकृतालोकस्तस्माद् रङ्गाद् विनिर्ययौ॥
en: Then king Duryodhana took Karna's hand and led him out of the arena lighted with countless lamps.

sa: तस्मिन्नियुक्ते विधिना योगक्षेमाय भार्गवे। अन्यमुत्पादयामास पुत्रं भृगुरनिन्दितम्॥
en: Thus appointed by Brahma to look after the welfare (of Daityas), Bhrigu's son (Shukra) begot another son.

sa: यदो त्वमसि धर्मज्ञो मदर्थं प्रतिगृह्यताम्। जरां परमिकां पुत्र भोगै रंस्ये महायशः॥ न तावत्कृतकृत्योऽस्मि विषयेषु नरर्षभ। अनुभूय तदा कामं ततः प्राप्स्याम्यहं जराम्॥
en: O Yadu you are cognisant of religion; do you therefore take this decrepitude for me; I shall satisfy myself with various enjoyments. O foremost of men, I have not yet been satisfied with worldly enjoyments, I shall therefore again take upon myself this decrepitude after having enjoyed all objects of sense.

sa: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य वसिष्ठः श्रेष्ठभागृषिः। विश्वामित्रं नरश्रेष्ठं प्रतिजग्राह पूजया॥
en: Seeing him coming, the illustrious and blessed Rishi, Vasishtha, advanced to salute that best of men, Vishvamitra.

sa: जयस्य हेतुः सिद्धिर्हि कर्म दैवं च संश्रितम्। संयुक्तो हि बलैः कश्चित् प्रमादान्नोपयुज्यते॥ तेन द्वारेण शत्रुभ्यः क्षीयते सबलो रिपुः॥ दैन्यं यथा बलवति तथा मोहो बलान्विते। तावुभौ नाशकौ हेतू राज्ञा त्याज्यौ जयार्थिना॥
en: Concentration of mind, exertion and destiny, (these three) exist as the three causes of victory. One who possesses velour, but does act with carelessness can never win victory; It is for this that a many endued with strength sometimes suffers death at the hands of his enemies. As meanness overtakes the weak, so folly sometimes overtakes the strong. A king therefore, who is desirous of victory, should forsake both these causes of destruction.

sa: श्रावयिष्यन्ति ये विप्रा ये च श्रोष्यन्ति मानवाः। सर्वथा वर्तमाना वै न ते शोच्याः कृताकृतैः॥
en: The Brahmanas who recite it for others to hear it and those who hear it, in whatever state duties, they may be, can never be affected by the fruits of good or bad deeds.

sa: जगाम मनसा चैव वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम्। पुरोहितममित्रघ्नस्तदा संवरणो नृपः॥
en: That chastiser of foes, the king Samvarana, also mentally thought of his priest, that excellent Rishi, Vasishtha.

sa: वारिणा च सुशीतेन शिरस्तस्याभ्यषेचयत्। अस्फुटन्मुकुटं राज्ञः पुण्डरीकसुगन्धिना॥
en: He sprinkled on the crewless head of the king cold water fragrant, with the perfume of lotus.

sa: विसृज्य लक्ष्मणं रामो दुःखशोकसमन्वितः। पुरोधसो मन्त्रिणश्च नैगमांश्चैदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having forsaken Lakşmaņa and being stricken with sorrow and grief Råma said to his citizens and ministers.

sa: लक्ष्मणेनैवमुक्तस्तु राम इक्ष्वाकुन्दनः। प्रत्युवाच महातेजा लक्ष्मणं पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Having been thus accosted by Lakşmaņa, Rāma, the descendant of Ikşvākus and the foremost of men, replied.

sa: रुधिरेणानुलिप्ताङ्गा निहताश्च महासुराः। अद्रीणामिव कूटानि धातुरक्तानि शेरते॥
en: The great Asuras, covered with blood, lay dead everywhere and they looked like red dyed mountain peaks.

sa: जलरूपिणयोज्येष्ठमृक्षमाहुर्जनाधिपम्। ऋक्षात् संवरणो जज्ञे राजन् वंशकरः सुतः॥
en: Riksha was elder than Jala and Rupina; he begot Samvarana, who was the perpetuator of the line.

sa: एकादशस्तथा त्वष्टा द्वादशो विष्णुरुच्यते। जघन्यजस्तु सर्वेषामादित्यानां गुणाधिकः॥
en: The eleventh was Tvashtri and the twelvth was Vishnu. The youngest, however, was the best in merit.

sa: मन्दपाल उवाच किमर्थमावृता लोका ममैते तपसार्जिताः किं मया न कृतं तत्र यस्यैतत् कर्मणः फलम्॥
en: Mandapala said : Why have these regions become unattainable by me? I thought they have been acquired by me by my asceticism. What have I not done, the fruits of which are these regions?

sa: भीमसेनोऽपि तद् रक्षः परिरभ्य महाभुजः। विस्फुरन्तं बलाद्
en: Bhimasena also clasped the Rakshasas by his strong arms. The mighty hero began to drag him violently.

sa: अथोद्यानवरे तस्मिंस्तथा क्रीडागताश्च ते। परस्परस्य वक्त्रेभ्यो ददुर्भक्ष्यांस्ततस्ततः॥ ततो दुर्योधनः पापस्तद्भक्ष्ये कालकूटकम्। विषं प्रक्षेपयामास भीमसेनजिघांसया॥
en: They then began to play and exchange morsels of food with one another. The wicked Duryodhana had mixed some virulent poison with the food of Bhimasena with the desire of making away with him.

sa: श्वेताः कृष्णाश्च नीलाश्च स्थविराः शिशवस्तथा। नदन्तो विविधान्नादान्पेतुर्दीप्ते विभावसौ॥ क्रोशयोजनमात्रा हि गोकर्णस्य प्रमाणतः। पतन्त्यजस्रवेगेन वन्हावग्निमतांवर॥
en: The white, the black, the blue, the old and the young, those measuring a crosa those measuring a Yojana and those measuring a Gokarna, all fell violently into that blazing fire uttering various cries.

sa: इत्यर्थमिष्यतेऽपत्यं तारयिष्यति मामिति। अस्मिन्नुपस्थिते काले तरध्वं प्लवन्मया॥
en: Men desire for children hoping, they will save them. Cross this stream of your difficulty by me.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गुरोः सकाशात् समवाप्य विद्यां भित्त्वा कुक्षि निर्विचक्राम विप्रः। कचोऽभिरूपस्तत्क्षणाद् ब्राह्मणस्य शुकात्यये पौर्णमास्यामिवेन्दुः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Receiving the knowledge (of reviving life) from his preceptor, the handsome Kacha ripped open the stomach (of Shukra) and came out like the moon on the evening of the full-moon night.

sa: पाण्डुः पुनर्मुदितवाहनः। हर्षयिष्यन् स्वराष्ट्राणि पुरं च गजसाह्वयम्॥
en: Pandu, returned to his own capital Hastinapur to the great delight of all his subjects and citizens.

sa: तेन शापेन धर्मोऽपि शूद्रयोनावजायत। विद्वान्विदुररूपेण धार्मी तनुरकिल्बिषी॥
en: Thus being cursed, Dharma was born as a Shudra as Vidura who was learned, virtuous and pure-bodied.

sa: मय उवाच अस्मात् कृष्णात् सुसंरब्धात् पावकाच्च दिधक्षतः। त्वया बातोऽस्मि कौन्तेय ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते॥
en: Maya said O son of Kunti, I have been saved by you from this angry Krishna and this Pavaka fire who was desirous of consuming me. Tell me what I shall do for you.

sa: ततस्तु सहितः सर्वैः सदस्यैर्जनमेजयः। इदं पश्चाद्विजश्रेष्ठं पर्यपृच्छत्कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Thereupon with joined hands, Janamejaya, with all his Sadasyas, addressed the best of the Brahmanas (Vyasa) thus:

sa: तत्र राजानमासीनं ददर्श जनमेजयम्। वृतं सदस्यैर्बहुभिर्देवैरिव पुरंदरम्॥
en: He saw there seated king Janamejaya surrounded by his numerous Sadasya like Indra surrounded by the celestials.

sa: सा त्वदीर्पण कालेन सम्प्राप्ता कुरुजाङ्गलम्। वर्धमानपुरद्वारमाससाद यशस्विनी॥
en: Arriving at Kurujangala within a very short time, the illustrious Kunti presented herself at the principal gate.

sa: अहो कष्टं क्षीणपुण्यो ययाति: पतत्यसौ पुण्यकृत् पुण्यकीर्तिः। तानब्रुवं पतमानस्ततोऽहं सतां मध्ये निपतेयं कथं नु॥
en: "What misfortune! The virtuous and meritorious Yayati is falling! His all religious merits are destroyed!” And when I was falling, I asked them, “Where are those wise ones amongst whom am I to fall?"

sa: शृण्वतां सर्वभूतानां तेषां चाश्रमवासिनाम्। कुन्तीमाभाष्य विस्पष्टमुवाचेदं शुचिस्मिताम्॥
en: Addressing Kunti, it said a distinct voice in the hearing of every creature dwelling in that hermitage,

sa: यस्मात्त्वं भोजनं राजन्ममैतद्दातुमिच्छसि। तस्माद्भोजनमेतत्ते भविष्यति न संशयः॥
en: "O king, let this be your food which you have offered me; this shall not prove otherwise."

sa: विचित्रवीर्यस्य तथा राज्ये संप्रतिपादनम्। धर्मस्य नृषु संभूतिरणीमाण्डव्यशापजा॥
en: His placing Vichitravirya on the throne, the birth of Dharma on account of the curse of Animandavya,

sa: शत्रुघ्नस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मुनिपुङ्गवः। प्रत्युवाच महात्मानं स्वागतं ते महायशः॥ स्वमाश्रममिदं सौम्य राघवाणां कुलस्य वै। आसनं पाद्यमयं च निर्विशङ्कः प्रतीच्छ मे॥
en: Hearing the words of the high-souled Śatrughna, Vālmīki, the foremost of ascetics, replied saying: “O you of great renown, do you wait here without any hesitation. O gentle one, this hermitage belongs to the descendants of the Raghu face. Do you fearlessly take your seat and water to wash your feet.”

sa: न च वो वसतस्तत्र कश्चिच्छक्तः प्रबाधितुम्। संरक्ष्यमाणान् पार्थेन त्रिदशानिव वज्रिणा॥ अर्धं राज्यस्य सम्प्राप्य खाण्डवप्रस्थमाविश।
en: If you live there, none will be able to injure you. Taking half of the kingdom, live at Khandavaprastha protected by Partha (Arjuna), as the celestials are by the wielder of the thunder (Indra).

sa: जनमेजय उवाच देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरंगरक्षसाम्। सिंहव्याघ्रमृगाणां च पन्नगानां पतत्रिणाम्॥ सर्वेषां चैव भूतानां संभवं भगवन्नहम्। श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन मानुषेषु महात्मनाम्। जन्म कर्म च भूतानामेतेषामनुपूर्वशः॥
en: Janamejaya said : Worshipful Sir, I desire to hear from you in detail the accounts of the births and deeds and achievements among men, of the Devas, the Danavas, the Rakshasas, the Gandharvas, the lions, the tigers, the snakes, the birds and other animals and in short of all creatures, that became incarnate in human forms.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु स पितॄश्चचार पृथिवीं मुनिः। न च स्म लभते भार्यां वृद्धोऽयमिति शौनक॥
en: Sauti said : The Rishi (Jaratkaru), having said all this to the ancestors, (left the place and) roamed over the world again. O Shaunaka, although he grew old, he did not get a wife.

sa: वयं चैव महाभाग जरासंधभयात् तदा। शङ्किताः स्म महाभाग दौरात्म्यात् तस्य चानघ॥ अहं हि तव दुर्द्धर्ष भुजवीर्याश्रयः प्रभो। नात्मानं बलिनं मन्ये त्वयि तस्माद् विशङ्किते॥
en: But, O exalted one, O sinless being, we also were all alarmed at the prowess and the wickedness of the king Jarasandha, O hero, invincible in battle, O lord, the prowess of your arms in our refuge. When you are alarıned at Jarasandha's might, how should I consider my self strong (enough to cope with him)?

sa: निवृत्तयज्ञस्वाध्याया प्रणष्टनृपतिद्विजा। उत्सन्नोत्सवयज्ञा च बभूव वसुधा तदा॥
en: Sacrifice and study ceased; kings and Brahmanas were exterminated. The earth became destitute of festivals and sacrifices.

sa: अपाने ह्यर्चिी यास्ते सर्वं भक्ष्यन्ति ताः शिखिन्। क्रव्यादा च तनुर्या ते सा सर्वं भक्षयिष्यति॥
en: O deity of flames, Only the flames, that are in the vilest part of your body, will eat all things, alike and the part of your body which eats will also eat all things.

sa: शकुनि सहदेवस्तु सहसैन्यमवाकिरत्। नकुल: पार्श्वत: स्थित्वा मद्राराजमवैक्षत॥
en: Sahadeva checked Shakuni and his detachment. Nakula looked at the king of the Madras from his flanks.

sa: निवृत्य तु महावीर्यो समुच्छ्रितमहागदौ। पुनरन्तरमार्गस्थौ मण्डलानि विचेरतुः॥
en: Having stopped for a moment those two energetic warriors once more, with uplifted maces, closed each other.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरं राजानमपराजितम्। अपोवाह रथेनाजौ सहदेवः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Meanwhile the valiant Şahadeva carried away the heroic but defeated king on his car from that battle.

sa: राजोवाच अर्थेषु भागी पुरुष ईहमानः पुनः पुनः। अलब्ध्वा मद्विधो राज्यं ब्रह्मन् किं कर्तुमर्हति॥ अन्यत्र मरणाद् दैन्यादन्यत्र परसंश्रयात्। क्षुद्रादन्यत्र चाचारात् तन्ममाचक्ष्व सत्तम॥
en: What should a person like me who is worthy to have wealth, but who has, after repeated attempts, failed to regain his kingdom, do, O Brahmana, excepting suicide, thieving and robbery, secking refuge with others, and other acts of meanness of a similar nature? O best of men, tell me this.

sa: तथैवामन्त्र्य गाङ्गेयं केशवः पाण्डवास्तथा। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य रथानारुरुहुः शुभान्॥
en: After this, Keshava and the Pandavas, saluting Bhishma and going round him, got upon their beautiful cars.

sa: नानामोहसमायुक्ता बुद्धिजालेन संवृताः॥ असूक्ष्मदृष्ट्यो मन्दा भ्राम्यन्ते तत्र तत्र ह। सुसूक्ष्मदृष्ट्यो राजन् व्रजन्ति ब्रह्म शाश्वतम्॥
en: Possessed by various kinds of mistakes, entangled by the net of their own intelligence, they that are wicked and are of good vision, visit repeatedly this Earth. The wise secure a union with Brahma."

sa: स दृष्ट्वा मांसजीवी तु सुभृशं क्षुच्छ्रमान्वितः। तु अभक्षयत् ततो ग्रीवामुष्ट्रस्य भरतर्षभ॥ यदा त्वबुध्यतात्मानं भक्ष्यमाणं स वै पशुः। तदा संकोचने यत्नमकरोद् भृशदुःखितः॥
en: Living as he did upon meat, and greatly hungry and tried as he was, O foremnost of Bharata's race, the jackal, seeing the camel's neck, began to eat as much of it as he could. When he perceived that his neck was being eaten, the camel tried sorrowfully to shorten it.

sa: आगच्छत्स्वथ कृष्णोऽपि पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु॥ शैनेयसहितो धीमान् रथमेवान्वपद्यत।
en: While the great Pandavas were coming, Krishna accompanied by the grandson of Shini, got upon his car.

sa: ततोऽवस्थाप्य राजेन्द्र कृतबुद्धिस्तवात्मजः॥ हर्षयन्निव तान् योधानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
en: Rallying his soldiers and cheering them up your son, who was bent upon keeping his honor, said-

sa: गदया युद्धकुशलस्तया दारुणनादया॥ पोथयामास शल्यस्य चतुरोऽश्वान् महाजवान्।
en: With that mace of dreadful sound Bhima, skilled in battle, crushed the four quickcoursing horses of Shalya.

sa: राहुश्चाग्रसदादित्यमपर्वणि विशाम्पते। चकम्पे च महाकम्पं पृथिवी सवनदुमा॥
en: Rahu devoured the Sun most untimely, O king! The Earth with her forest and trees shook violently.

sa: त्रिंसाहस्रास्तथा राजंस्तव पुत्रेण चोदिताः॥ अयोधयन्त विजयं द्रोणपुत्रपुरस्कृताः।
en: Three thousand cars, O king, dispatched by your son and headed by Drona's son, fought with Vijaya.

sa: राजन्नात्मानमाचक्षे सम्बन्धी भवतो ह्यहम्। मुनिः कालकवृक्षीय इत्येवमभिसंज्ञितः॥
en: I speak of myself, O king! I am your friend. I am known as the sage Kalakavrikshiya.

sa: भवत् तपोविघातो वा यदि स्याद् विरमे ततः। यदि वास्ति कथायोगो योऽयं प्रश्नो मयेरितः॥ एतत् कारणसामर्थ्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः। भवन्तोऽपि तपोनित्या ब्रूयुरेतत् समन्विताः॥
en: If again the subject be injurious to your penances, I would not wish you to describe. If the question asked by me be a befitting subject of discourse, I would then wish to hear the cause fully. Devoted to penances as ye are, do ye all instruct me on the subject.'

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच तुल्यबाहुबलानां च तुल्यानां च गुणैरपि। कथं स्यादधिकः कश्चित् स च भुजीत मानवान्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Of persons all of whom are equal in strength of arms and accomplishments' how does one reign supreme over all the others, and how does he succeed in lording over them all.

sa: बाह्यान्तरं च भूतानां स्वभावं पश्य भारत। ये तु पश्यन्ति तद् भूतं मुच्यन्ते ते महाभयात्॥
en: Know, O Bharata, the hearts and the bodies of all creatures to be but manifestations of your own. They who regard all creatures as their own selves escape from the great fear of Death.

sa: पितुः सखा च भवतः सम्मतः सत्यसङ्गरः। सर्वकामान् परित्यज्य तपस्तप्तं तदा मया। स्नेहात् त्वां तु ब्रवीम्येतन्मा भूयो विभ्रमेदिति॥ व्यापन्ने भवतो राज्ये राजन् पितरि संस्थिते॥
en: Always follow truth. Your father knew me as his friend. When distress overtook this kingdom during the reign of your father, O king, I performed many penances (for driving it off). Leaving off every other business. Out of my affection for you I say this to you so that you may not again commit the fault.

sa: रथमार्ग ततश्चक्रे भीमसेनो पहाबलः॥ पाण्डवानां महाराज व्यपाकर्षन्महागजान्।
en: Then the powerful Bhimasena, O king, dragging away those huge elephants, made a way for the Pandavas.

sa: यश्च वेदः स वै धर्मो यश्च धर्मः स सत्पथः। ब्रह्मा पितामहः पूर्वं बभूवाथ प्रजापतिः॥
en: That which is the Veda is morality and duty. What is morality and duty is the path of Righteousness. This last in the beginning had been the Grandfather Brahman, that Lord of all creatures.

sa: स हि तीव्रण तपसा सम्भृतः परमर्षिणा॥ प्रजापतिसुतेनाथ भृगुणा लोकभावनः। अतिकायः स तेजस्वी लोकसारो विनिर्मितः.॥ जज्ञे शैलगुरुः प्रांशुर्महिम्ना प्रथितः प्रभुः। नित्यमुद्विजते चास्य तेजसः पाकशासनः॥
en: Equal to the Creator himself Dadhicha, had been begotten by the penances of great Rishi Bhrigu. Strongly built and highly energetic Dadhicha had been made the strongest of men in the world. The powerful and glorious Dadhicha, became tall like the king of mountains. The chastiser of Paka had always been in dread of his power.

sa: गान्धारराजं शीघ्रास्त्रमनुसृत्य यशस्विनौ॥ नचिरात् प्रत्यदृश्येतां माद्रीपुत्रौ ससात्यकी।
en: Having pursued the light-handed king of Gandharvas the illustrious twins and Satyaki again appeared (amongst the Pandavas.)

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच न तेऽभिशंके वचनं यद् ब्रवीषि तपोधन। अपरोक्षो हि ते धर्मः सर्वधर्मविदां वर॥
en: Yudhishthira said I do not doubt your words, O you of great ascetic merit? Everything regarding morality and duty is well known to you, O foremost of all persons, conversant with morality and duty.

sa: मद्रराजः सुसंक्रद्धो गृहीत्वा धनुरुत्तमम्। अभ्यद्रवत संग्रामे पाण्डवानाततायिनः॥
en: Enraged the king of the Madras, taking up an excellent bow, rushed for battle against the Pandavas.

sa: वेत्रव्यासक्तहस्ताश्च द्वाराध्यक्षा विशाम्पते॥ शयनीयानि शुभ्राणि स्पास्तरणवन्ति च।
en: The camp-guards quickly fled towards the city, taking with them many white beds covered with rich sheets.

sa: तस्य दृष्ट्वा महत्त्वं ते महेन्द्रस्येव देवताः। अपतत्रसिरे सर्वे स्वधर्मे च ददुर्मनः॥ ततो महीं परिययौ पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्। शमयन् सर्वतः पापान् स्वकर्मसु च योजयन्॥
en: Seeing the power of Manu, like the gods seeing the might of Indra, the inhabitants of the Earth became stricken with fear and began to follow their respective duties. Manu then went round the world suppressing everywhere all acts of wickedness and compelling all men to follow their respective duties, like a cloud surcharged with rain.

sa: ततः कुमारमादाय देवा ब्रह्मपुरोगमाः। अभिषेकार्थमाजग्मुः शैलेन्द्र सहितास्ततः॥
en: Then the gods headed by Brahman, taking that youth with them, came in a body to Himavat.

sa: दिष्ट्या गाण्डीवधन्वा च पाण्डवश्च वृकोदरः। त्वं चापि कुशली राजन् माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥ मुक्ता वीरक्षयादस्मात् संग्रामाल्लोमहर्षणात्। क्षिप्रमुत्तरकालानि कुरु कार्याणि पाण्डव॥ हतो वैकर्तनो राजन् सूतपुत्रो महारथः। दिष्ट्या जयसि राजेन्द्र दिष्ट्या वर्धसि भारत॥
en: By good fortune, the holder of the Gandiva bow, Pandu's son Vrikodara yourself and the two sons of Madri are all safe from his herodestroying and hair-stirring battle. Do what should next be done, O son of Pandu. The powerful son of the charioteer alas! Vaikartana has been killed. By good luck, O king of kings, you have achieved victory and by good fortune, you have gained over others, O son of Pandu.

sa: न त्वेदतद्भुतं वीरा यद् वो महदिदं मनः। अस्मासु च परा भक्तिर्न तु कालः पराक्रमे॥
en: It is no wonder, O heroes, that you are extolling me thus for your hearts are noble. Your devotion to me is also great. This, however, is not the proper time for displaying power.

sa: ते विधूमाः प्रदीप्ताश्च दीप्यमानाश्च पावकाः। नभसीवान्वदृश्यन्त ग्रहास्तन्वभ्रसंवृताः॥
en: The funeral fires, smokeless and burning brightly looked like shining planets in the sky enveloped by clouds.

sa: एवमुक्त्वार्जुनं कृष्णः सैनिकानिदमब्रवीत्। परानभिमुखा यत्तास्तिष्ठध्वं भद्रमस्तु वः॥
en: Having thus accosted Arjuna Krishna addressed the soldiers, saying-"Blessings unto you all. Stand, confronting the enemies carefully."

sa: हतैर्मनुष्याश्वगजैश संख्ये शरापविद्धैश्च रथैनरेन्द्र। रगम्यरूपा वसुधा बभूव॥
en: The entire field was blackened with carcasses, corpses, broken cars and arrows shot by Partha and Karna.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीत्सुसंक्रुद्धो वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाबलः। प्रगृह्य परिघं घोरं मांसशोणितदूषितम्॥
en: Then the exceedingly powerful Vajradańșțra, wielding up a terrific bludgeon, stained with flesh and gore, wrathfully observed.

sa: हृष्टप्रमुदिता लङ्का मत्तद्विपसमाकुला। महती रथसंपूर्णा रक्षोगणनिषेविता ॥
en: Lankā, filled with mad elephants, ever rejoice. She is great, thronging with cars and inhabited by Raksasas.

sa: विक्रोशमानश्चान्योन्यं जनो गां पर्यटिष्यति। ततस्तुमुलसङ्घाते वर्तमाने युगक्षये॥
en: Men in great affliction will rove over the (various) countries. When this terrible age would be over,

sa: कपिल उवाच शरीरपक्तिः कर्माणि ज्ञानं तु परमा गतिः। कषाये कर्मभिः पक्वे रसज्ञाने च तिष्ठति।॥ आनृशंस्यं क्षमा शान्तिरहिंसा सत्यमार्जवम्। अद्रोहोऽनभिमानश्च ह्रीस्तितिक्षा शमस्तथा॥
en: Kapila said-Acts only purify the body, Knowledge, however, is the highest end. When all defects of the heart are cured, and when the happiness of Brahma becomes established in knowledge. benevolence, forgiveness, tranquillity, mercy, truthfulness, and open-mindedness, abstention from injury, absence of pride, modestry, renunciation, and abstention from work are acquired.

sa: विषण्णवदनश्चापि युयुधानोऽभवननृप। भारद्वाजं रणे दृष्ट्वा विसृजन्तं शिताशरान्॥
en: Then, O king Yuyudhana's face became cheerless, as he saw Drona discharge numerous sharp arrows in battle.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यः स धर्मः पुरा दृष्टः सद्भिः शैनेय शाश्वतः। साम्पराये सुहृत्कृत्ये तस्य कालोऽयमागतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O grandson of Sini, the hour for that duty which sages of the past have enjoined to be done towards a friend by a friend in times of nced, has now arrived.

sa: मां प्राप्य हि गुणो दोषः संवृत्तः पश्य लक्ष्मण। अद्यैव सर्वभूतानां रक्षसामभवाय च॥ संहत्यैव शशिज्योत्स्नां महान् सूर्य इवोदितः। संहत्यैव गुणान् सर्वान् मम तेजः प्रकाशते॥
en: Observe, O Laksmana, obtaining me as the stay these accomplishments have been turned into so many blemishes. Truly shall my prowess manifest itself to-day overshadowing all my other accomplishments for the destruction of the Rākşasas and all created beings like to the rising of the Sun casting the Moon into shade on the day of dissolution.

sa: व्युत्थानं च विकाङ्क्षद्भिः कथाभिः प्रतिलोभ्यते। चैव बुद्धिरस्य विलोभ्यते॥ न चापि स महाप्राज्ञस्तस्माद् धैर्याच्चचाल ह।
en: Seeking aggrandisement and prosperity, they began to tempt him with sweet words. Indeed, large bribes even were offered to tempt his heart. Highly wise, the jackal showed no signs of yielding to those temptations.

sa: तिर्यग्योनिसहस्राणि गत्वा नरकमेव च। निर्गच्छन्त्यवशा जीवाः कामबन्धनबन्धनाः॥
en: Fettered by the bonds of Desire, creatures pass through numberless intermediate lives and fall helplessly into hell.

sa: मत्कृते दुःखमापन्नं क्लेशं प्राप्तमनन्तकम्। कृतं हि तव पुत्रैश्च परेषामवरोधनम्। मत्प्रियार्थं पुरैवैतद् विदितं ते नरोत्तम॥
en: And who may for my doings be beset with troubles and endless woes. The enemies were opposed by your sons simply for our good; which is known to you before, O best among men.

sa: नाहं शरीरेण वसामि देवि नैवं मया शक्यमिहाभिधातुम्। भावेन यस्मिन् निवसामि पुंसि स वर्धते धर्मयशोर्थकामैः॥
en: Can I not say, O lady, that I do not live in my embodied form? That person in whom I live in spirit increases in virtue and fame and wealth and object of desire.

sa: तान्दृष्ट्वा निधुतान्रामो रुष्टोऽयमिति राक्षसम्। समुत्पपात वेगेन धनुरुत्तममाददे॥
en: Rāghava seeing them shaken, and concluding the Rāksasa to be wroth, furiously sprang forward, taking his bow.

sa: पृष्ट्वा कुशलमव्यग्रं वैदेही मिथिलाधिपः। कौशिकानुमते वाक्यं भवन्तमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: After having enquired after your complete welfare, Mithila's lord, Vaideha, by permission of Kausika, addresses you thus,

sa: इत्येवं चिन्तयित्वाथ हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। भूयः संस्तम्भयामास वानराणां महाचमूम्॥
en: Thinking thus within himself, Hanumăn, that son of Maruta, began to stay the mighty host of Monkeys.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यमस्तु यानि श्राद्धानि प्रोवाच शशविन्दवे। तानि मे शृणु काम्यानि नक्षत्रेषु पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: Bhishma said Hear me, O Yudhishthira, as I tell you what those optional Shraddhas are that should be performed under the different constellations and that were first spoken of by Yama of king Shashabindu.

sa: मा वः प्रियायाः सुनसं सुलोचनं चन्द्रप्रभाच्छं वदनं प्रसन्नम्। स्पृश्याच्छुभं कश्चिदकृत्यकारी श्वा वै पुरोडाशमिवाध्वरस्थम्। एतानि वान्यनुयात शीनं मा वः कालः क्षिप्रमिहात्यगाद् वै॥
en: Let no mean man touch with his lips the brilliant and charming face of your wife, delightful as the rays of the moon, having high nose and beautiful eyes like a dog licking ghee kept in a sacrificial pot. Go speedily by this way and let not time go before you."

sa: यतो यतः पाण्डवेयः प्रविष्टो रथसत्तमः। ततस्ततोऽघातयत योधाशतसहस्रशः॥
en: (And) there that son of Pandu, the best of car-warriors, rushed in, slaying hundred thousands of enemy.

sa: तस्यागस्त्यो बहुगुणं कन्दमूलं तथौषधम्। शाल्यादीनि पवित्राणि भोजनार्थमकल्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon the great ascetic offered him food many substantial Kanda, roots, Osadhis and the holy Sali rice.

sa: ततः सुबाहुस्त्रिं शद्भिरद्रिसारमयैः शरैः। अविध्यदिषुभिर्गाढं किरीटे सव्यसाचिनम्॥
en: Thereafter Subahu deeply stuck on the diadem of Savyasachi (Arjuna) thirty shafts made of the hardest adamant.

sa: यथा प्रभातं रजनी कल्पितः स्याद् रथो मम। तथा कार्यं त्वया कृष्ण कार्यं हि महदुद्यतम्॥
en: O Krishna, you should so arrange that as soon as the night passes away, my chariot may be ready, well-furnished with the implements of war, inasmuch as the task at hand is very serious.

sa: अनुविन्दस्तु गदया कुन्तिभोजमताडयत्। कुन्तिभोजश्च तं तूर्णं शरवातैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Anuvinda hurled a mace of Kuntibhoja but he (Kuntibhoja) soon covered him with a shower of arrows.

sa: हतोत्तमाङ्गाः केचित् तु तथैवोद्यतकार्मुकाः। प्रगृहीतायुधाश्चापि तस्थुः पुरुषसत्तमाः॥
en: Some brave combatants with heads cut off still stood with weapons in their grasp and with bows.

sa: भद्राश्वः केतुमालश्च जम्बूद्वीपश्च भारत। उत्तराश्चैव कुरवः कृतपुण्यप्रतिश्रयाः॥
en: Namely Bhadrashva, Ketumala, Jambudvipa also called Bharata, and Uttara Kuru which is the abode of the pious.

sa: यतो धर्मस्ततः कृष्णो यत: कृष्णस्ततो जयः। युद्ध्यस्व गच्छ कौन्तेये पृच्छं मां किं ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Drona said Where there is righteousness there is Krishna. Where there is Krishna, victory is certain to be there. O son of Kunti, go and fight. Ask me, what shall I speak to you?

sa: अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ॥
en: The son of Kunti, king Yudhishthira, Ananta Vijaya and Nakula and Sahadeva Sughosha and Mani Pushpaka respectively.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु संक्रुद्धौ दुर्योधनममर्षणम्। हृद्यविध्यत् पृषत्केन प्रहसन्निव पाण्डवः॥
en: Then the Pandava Bhimasena angrily and smilingly wounded the vindictive Duryodhana in the breast with an arrow.

sa: तस्य क्रुद्धो महाराज पाण्डवः शत्रुतापनः। अप्रैषीद् विशिखान् घोरान् यमदण्डोपमान् बहून्॥ अप्राप्तानेव तान् बाणांश्चिच्छेद तनयस्तव।
en: Then Arjuna, the afflicter of foes, with enger, O king! shot at him numerous dreadful arrows resembling the mace of Death himself. Then your son cut off those arrows before they could reach him.

sa: वर्णरुच्चावचैरन्यैः सदश्वानां प्रभद्रकाः। संन्यवर्तन्त युद्धाय बहवो देवरूपिणः॥
en: Hosts of the Prabhadrakas of divine appearance, proceeded to battle, on superior chargers of various beautiful colours,

sa: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत। सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः॥
en: To him, who overcome with despondency in the midst of the two armies. Hrishikesha thus spoke smiling.

sa: कृतवर्माणमेकेन शल्यं पञ्चभिराशुगैः। विद्ध्वा नवभिरान च्छिताचैः प्रपितामहम्॥
en: Wounding Kritvarma with one arrow and Shalya with five, he weakened his great grandfather with nine arrows.

sa: बृहद्बलश्च कौसल्यश्चित्रसेनो विविंशतिः। रथाश्च बहुसाहस्राः शोभनाश्च महाध्वजाः॥
en: Brihadabala the ruler of the Kosalas Chitrasena, Vivingshati, with many thousand of car-warriors, decorated with tall standards,

sa: सोऽभिगम्य महाबाहुः पितरं सत्यविक्रमः। अभ्यवादयदव्यग्रो विनयेन कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: That mighty-armed hero of infallible prowess, approaching his father did obeisance to him, duly folding his palms.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ चित्रसेनश्च संयुगे।॥ दुर्मर्षणो विकर्णश्च सिन्धुराजश्च वीर्यवान्।
en: And Vinda and Anuvinda from Avanti, and Chitrasena, and Durmarshana Vikarna, the valiant ruler of the Sindhus,

sa: पृष्ठतोऽप्यर्जुनस्यासीद् युयुधानो महाबलः। चक्ररक्षौ तु पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ॥
en: Behind Arjuna stood the mighty Yuyudhana; and the two Panchala princes, Yudhamanyu add Uttamaujas protected Arjuna's chariot.

sa: नारद उवाच ते शशबिन्दुं च राजानं मृतं सृञ्जय शुश्रुमा ईजे स विविधैर्यज्ञैः श्रीमान् सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: Narada said We also heard, O Srinjaya, that king Shashabindu, who was of great personal beauty and of prowess incapable of being repulsed and who performed numerous and diverse sacrifices, had to undergo death.

sa: संछिद्य चापानि च तानि राज्ञां तेषां रणे वीर्यवतां क्षणेन। विव्याध बाणैर्युगपन्महात्मा नि:शेषतां तेष्वथ मन्यमानः॥
en: Within a moment having severed the bows of those highly powerful monarchs in the battle, O king, that illustrious hero setting his mind upon their destruction began to pierce them simultaneously with his arrows.

sa: क्षत्रदेवब्रह्मदेवो रथस्थौ पुरुषर्षभौ। जघनं पालयन्तौ च पृष्ठतोऽनुप्रजग्मतुः॥
en: And those foremost among men, seated on their chariots, Kshatradeva and Brahmadeva, followed behind, protecting the rear.

sa: प्रभिन्नाश्च महानागा विनीता हस्तिसादिभिः। परस्परं समासाद्य संनिपेतुरभीतवत्॥
en: Huge-elephants with rent temples and goaded on by their riders, approached and fell upon one another dauntlessly.

sa: धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान्। पुरुजित् कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः॥
en: There are Dhrishtaketu, Chekitan and valiant king of Kashi, Purujit, Kuntibhoja and that kings of men, Shaivya.

sa: तस्य पर्वतसंकाशा व्यरोचन्त महागजाः यन्त्रतोमरतूणीरैः पताकाभिः सुशोभिताः॥
en: His clephants cach loO king like a hill adorned with machines, lances, and standards looked very beautiful.

sa: कर्णस्तु केकयान् भ्रातॄन् पञ्च लोहितकध्वजान्। द्रोणायाभिमुखं याताशरव(रवारयत्॥
en: Karna checked with an arrowy shower the Kekaya brothers owning crimson standards, as they rushed towards Drona.

sa: मम ह्यभाग्यानि पुरा कृतानि पापानि नूनं बलवन्ति युद्धे॥ तृणं च कृत्वा समरे भवन्तं ततोऽहमेवं निकृतो दुरात्मना। वैकर्तनेनैव तथा कृतोऽहं यथा ह्यशक्तः क्रियते ह्यबान्धवः॥
en: It seems with certainty that the debited account of sins committed earlier coupled with misfortune have gathered momentum to harass me at this juncture of life. Wicked Kara has humiliated me by treating you as brittle as a straw. Karna had behead with me as if I am without siblings and relations and a helpless man.

sa: अन्तरिक्षे महानादो भूतानामभवन्नृप॥ अब्रवीच पुनस्तत्र त्वरमाणो जनार्दनः।
en: Loud shouts were heard, O king, in the welkin. Then Janardana once more quickly addressing Arjuna said

sa: अभ्ययुः पाण्डवं युद्धे विसृजन्तः शिलीमुखान्। चित्रोपचित्रश्चित्राक्षश्चारुचित्र: शरासनः॥
en: Rushed against Pandu's son in battle shooting numerous sharp arrows. They were Chitra, Upachitra, Chitraksha, Charuchitra, Chitrasana.

sa: तथा युधिष्ठिरस्तूर्णं भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। पृथक्कमूभ्यां संयत्तौ द्रोणमेवाभ्यधावताम्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira together with the Pandava Bhimasena joined by their separate squadrons soon rushed against Drona himself.

sa: सुवर्णजालापिहिता मणिजालैश्च कुञ्जराः॥ रेजुरभ्यधिकं संख्ये विद्युत्वन्त इवाम्बुदाः।
en: Covered with net-works of gold and gems the elephants looked greatly beautiful like clouds charged with lightning.

sa: मुनयश्चारणाः सिद्धा वैनतेया वयांसि च॥ रत्नानि निधयः सर्वे वेदाश्चाख्यानपञ्चमाः। सोपवेदोपनिषदः सरहस्याः ससंग्रहाः॥ वासुकिश्चित्ररेग्नश्च तक्षको मणिकस्तथा। सर्पाश्चैव तथा सर्रे काद्रवेयाश्च सान्वयाः॥ विषवन्तो महाराज नागाश्चार्जुनतोऽभवन्। ऐरावताः सौरभेया वैशालेयाश्च भोगिनः॥ एतेऽभवन्नर्जुनतः क्षुद्रसर्माश्च कर्णतः।
en: All the valuable jewels, the four Vedas, the Mahabharata, the Upavedas, the Upanishads with all their mysterious contents, the Vasuki and Chitrasena, the Takshaka and Upatakshaka, the mountains and the and all the descendants of the Kadru and their children with all the poisonous great snakes and Nagas were on Arjuna's side. Airavata with his children, the descendants of Saurabhai and Vaikati and the Bhojins all favoured Arjuna the smaller snakes sided Karna.

sa: सोऽयं प्रियः सखा चास्मि धार्तराष्ट्रस्य धीमतः॥४५ तदर्थे हि मम प्राणा यच मे विद्यते वसु। व्यक्तं त्वमप्युपहितः पाण्डवैः पापदेशज॥ यथा चामित्रवत् सर्वं त्वमस्मासु प्रवर्तसे।
en: I am the dear friend of the intelligent son of Dhritarashtra. For him are my vital airs and the wealth that I possess. As for you, born as you are in a sinful country it is clear that you have been bribed by the Pandavas as because you behave towards us in everything like an enemy.

sa: अनार्यं सुनृशंसं च धर्मपुत्रस्य मे श्रुतम्। युद्धेष्वपि प्रवृत्तानां ध्रुवं जयपराजयौ॥ द्वतमेतद् भवेद् राजन् वधस्तत्र प्रशस्यते। न्यायवृत्तो वधो यस्तु संग्रामे युध्यतो भवेत्॥
en: I have also heard of the vile and ruthless act of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira. Surely either victory or its reverses will fall to the lot of those who engage in fight. Death in battle is ever esteemed. The death overtaking one engaged in fight under fair rules of combat.

sa: विकृष्य बलवञ्चापं तव पुत्राय सोऽसृजत्। स तं निभिद्य वेगेन भित्त्वा च कवचं महत्॥ प्राविशद् धरणी राजन् वल्मीकमिव पन्नगः। ततः सम्मुमुहे राजस्तव पुत्रो महारथः॥
en: Then having stretched his bow with great force, he shot that arrow at your son. O monarch, that shaft, after having successively pierced with great force through his body and his strong armour, itself entered into the earth, even as the snakes enter into the ant-hill. Thereupon, O king, your son, that mighty carwarrior, became senseless.

sa: द्विरदं जलसन्धस्य रुधिरेणाभ्यषिञ्चत। जलसन्धं निहत्याजौ त्वरयाणस्तु सात्वतः॥
en: Then drenched Jalasandha's elephant with blood. Having slain Jalasandha in battle, he of the Satvata race speedily.

sa: तथैव तौ प्रत्यविध्यत् सूतपुत्रःप्रतापवान्। भल्लाभ्यां शितधाराभ्यां महात्मानावरिंदमौ॥
en: Then his highly powerful son of the charioteer struck those high-souled and victorious heroes with sharpened darts.

sa: तमभिद्रुतमालोक्य द्रोणेनामित्रघातिना॥ हाहेति सहसा शब्दः पाण्डूनां समजायत।
en: Beholding the king assailed by Drona that slayer of foes the Pandavas began to exclaim saying, 'Alas'.

sa: ततः प्रायाद्हृषीकेशो रथेनाप्रतियोधिना। दारुणश्च पुनस्तत्र प्रादुरासीत् समागमः॥
en: Thereupon, Hrishikesha went (to the battle), ascending on an irresistible car. Then there raged a dreadful battle.

sa: वारणाश्च महाराज समासाद्य परस्परम्। विषाणैर्दारयामासुः सुसंक्रुद्धा मदोत्कटाः॥
en: Furious elephants mad with rage, O mighty monarch, advancing against one another, mangled one another with tusks.

sa: ततो भीमो महाबाहुः सात्यकिश्च महारथः। अभिवाद्य गुरुं ज्येष्ठं मार्गणैः क्षतविक्षतौ॥ क्षितावास्तां महेष्वासौ पाञ्चाल्यैः परिवारितौ। तौ दृष्ट्वा मुदितौ वीरौ प्राञ्जली चाग्रतः स्थितौ॥
en: The long armed Bhimasena and great chariot holder Stayaki with their bodies injured of arrows then bowed their heads on the feet of Yudhishthira and stood on the ground. Having seen those great archers with folded hands and in charms on their faces; Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti greeted them heartily.

sa: तथापरे द्योतमाना ज्योतीषीवामलाम्बरे। प्रादुरासन् महाराज कार्णायसमया गुडाः॥
en: Then, O ruler of earth, countless iron balls appeared there like lustrous orbs in the cloudless firmament.

sa: अर्जुनो भीमसेनश्च सात्यक्श्चिपराजितः॥ विजित्य सर्वसैन्यानि सुमहान्ति महारथाः।
en: Arjuna and Bhimasena and the invincible Satyaki and many other mighty car-warriors, having defeated all our troops.

sa: विव्याध चैनं समरे नाराचैस्तत्र सप्तभिः। तंप्रत्यविध्यच्छैनेयः शरैर्हेमपरिष्कृतैः॥
en: He pierced him with seven arrows. The grandson of Sini, in return, struck him with golden-feathered arrows.

sa: हयाः ससूता निहता नरेन्द्र चूर्णीकृतश्चास्य रथः पतन्त्या। दुःशासनं पाण्डवाः प्रेक्ष्य सर्वे हृष्टाः पञ्चालाः सिंहनादानमुञ्चन॥
en: O king! That gada crushed in pieces the chariot of Duhshasana with a hard blow and killed his horses with charioteer. Pandavas and Panchala warriors expressed loud ecstasy when they saw Duhshasana so lost.

sa: एवं महच्छस्रवर्षं सृजन्त स्ते यातुधाना भुवि घोररूपाः। मायासृष्टास्तत्र घटोत्कचेन नामुञ्चन् वै याचमानं न भीतम्॥
en: Those Yatudhanas of terrible forms created by Ghatotkacha by the help of his illusive powers, pouring that thick shower of mighty weapons, spread neither those that were frightened nor those that begged for mercy.

sa: अतिष्ठदाहवे द्रोणो विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्। तमाजिशीर्षादेकान्तमपक्रान्तं निशम्य तु॥
en: Stood like fire free from smoke. Then beholding him move away from the field (towards the North).

sa: तस्मिन्नुतपतमाने च प्रचचाल वसुन्धरा। महोर्मिकलितावर्तश्चुक्षुभे स महोदधिः॥
en: When that being appeared, the Earth shook. The Ocean became agitated with mountain billows and dreadful eddies.

sa: को हि स्थातुमलं लोके मम क्रुद्धस्य संयुगे॥ कालस्तु बलवान् प्राप्तस्तेन तिष्ठसि वासव। यत् तद् वर्षसम्रान्तं पूर्णं भवितुमर्हति॥ यथा मे सर्वगात्राणि न सुस्थानि महौजसः।
en: Formerly, when I used to become angry, what person was there on Earth who could stand before me in battle? Time however, is stronger. He has overwhelmed me. It is therefore, O Vasava, that you are able to stand before me. Those thousand celestial years, over which your reign extends will surely come to an end.

sa: तेजो वायौ तु संसक्तं वायुं नभसि चाश्रितम्। नभो महति संयुक्तं महद् बुद्धौ च संश्रितम्॥
en: Heat attaches itself to the Wind; and the Wind has Ether for its refuge; and Space has the principle of greatness for its refuge; and the principle of greatness has Understanding for its basis.

sa: भीमः सुघोरश्च तथा नीलमेघसमप्रभः। अस्मिञ्छवं परित्यज्य प्रेतकार्याण्युपासत॥
en: It appears dreadful like a mass of blue clouds. Casting off the body, perform the funeral rites.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। कपिलस्य गोश्च संवादं तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Kapila and the cow. Listen to it, O Yudhishthira.

sa: तत्र साक्षरते देवी दिव्या गौः सुरनन्दिनी॥ तस्याहं तत् पयः पीत्वा रसेन ह्यमृतोपमम्। ज्ञात्वा क्षीरगुणांश्चैव उपलभ्य हि सम्भवम्॥ स च पिष्टरसस्तात न मे प्रीतिमुपावहत्।
en: A celestial cow, who delights the gods, was being milked on that occasion. Drinking her milk that resembled nectar in taste, I knew the virtues of milk. I, therefore, at once understood the substance that my mother offered me, for milk. Verily, the taste of that cake, O son, did not give me any pleasure whatever.

sa: सम्पश्यत जगत् सर्वं सुखदुःखैरधिष्ठितम्। संयोगो विप्रयोगश्च पर्यायेणोपलभ्यते॥
en: See, the entire universe is subject to happiness and misery. Union and disunion are seen in turns.

sa: असिर्विशसनः खड्गस्तीक्ष्णधारो दुरासदः। श्रीगर्भो विजयश्चैव धर्मपालस्तथैव च॥
en: Those names then are Asi, Vaishasana, Khadga, Sharp-edged, hard of acquisition, Shrigarbha, victory and protector of virtue.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अन्तरा प्रातराशं च सायमाशं तथैव च। सदोपवासी स भवेद् योन भुङ्क्तेऽन्तरा पुनः॥
en: Bhishma said He will be considered as one who is always fasting if he eats once during the day and once during the night at the fixed hours without eating anything in the interim.

sa: ततः पञ्चशतं शूराः समुद्यतमहाशिलाः। निकृत्तबाहवो राजन् निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: Fell down, O king with their arms severed. Again a thousand warriors and other hundred thousand warriors.

sa: षष्ठिः कोट्योऽभवंस्तासामप्सराणां सुवर्चसाम्। असंख्येयास्तु काकुत्स्थ यास्तासां परिचारिकाः॥
en: There sprang sixty koțis of shining Apsaras. And, O Kākutstha, the female attendants of those are numberless.

sa: कालस्य नयने युक्ता यमस्य पुरुषाश्च ये। तस्यां शिंशपपालाशास्तथा काशकुशादयः। उपासते धर्मराजं मूर्तिमन्तो जनाधिप॥ एते चान्ये च बहवः पितृराजसभासदः। न शक्याः परिसंख्यातुं नामभिः कर्मभिस्तथा॥
en: Those officers of Yama who have been appointed to count the allotted days of every body and every thing, Shingshapalasha, Kasha, and Kusha trees and all plants in their spiritual form, o king, waited upon Dharmaraja (Yama). These and many others are the Savasadhas (members of the assembly-hall) of the king of the Pitris (Yama). am

sa: राहोर्विक्रोशमानस्य प्रागेवालक्षितं स्वरम्। श्रुत्वेन्द्रोवाच मा भैषीरहमेनं निषूदये॥
en: Understanding everything by the piteous accents of Rāhu Indra said, “No fear, I shall soon slay him.”

sa: तं माता प्रत्युवाच-'व्यक्तं त्वया तत्रापराद्धम्, येनास्यभिहतः' इति॥
en: And then his mother said, "You must have committed some fault, for which you have been beaten.'

sa: यानि नामानि ते देव कीर्तितानि महर्षिभिः। वेदेषु सपुराणेषु यानि गुह्यानि कर्मभिः॥ तेषां निरुक्तं त्वत्तोऽहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि केशव। न ह्यन्यो वर्ण येन्नाम्नां निरुक्तं त्वामृते प्रभो॥
en: I wish to hear from you in detail, O Keshava, the meanings of all those names of yours, O God, which have been mentioned by the great Rishis in the Vedas and the Puranas on account of various acts of yours! None else than you, O Lord, is capable to explain the mcanings of those names.

sa: कुञ्जरस्येव संग्रामे परिगृह्याङ्कुशग्रहम्। ब्राह्मणैर्विप्रहीणस्य क्षत्रस्य क्षीयते बलम्॥
en: Like an elephant without a driver in battle, the strength of a Kshatriya, without a Brahmana, decreases.

sa: नकुल उवाच उक्तं बहुविधं वाक्यं धर्मराजेन माधव। धर्मज्ञेन वदान्येन श्रुतं चैव हि तत् त्वया॥
en: Nakula said Words of different degrees of worth have been said by the just king, O Madhava, who knows what righteousness is and who is benevolent; and they have all been heard by you.

sa: न शेकुश्चलितुं केचित् संनिपत्य स्था रथैः। प्रभिन्नास्तु महाकायः संनिपत्य गजा गजैः॥ बहुधादारयन् क्रुद्धा विषाणैरितरेतरम्। सतोरणपताकैश वारणा वरवारणैः॥ अभिसृत्य महाराज वेगवद्भिर्महागजैः। दन्तैरभिहतास्तत्र चुक्रुशुः परमातुराः॥
en: Some cars were obstructed by other cars and they were unable to move. Huge elephants with rent temples fell upon other huge elephants. They angrily tore one another's body with their tusks. O king, others, again, attacking other impetuous and huge ones with huge standards on their backs, being wounded by tusks, roared in great agony.

sa: अर्जुनो रथिनां श्रेष्ठो धृष्टद्युम्नमुवाच ह। शिखण्डिनं नरव्याघ्नं भीष्मस्य प्रमुखे नृप। स्थापयस्वाद्य पाञ्चाल्य तस्य गोप्ताहमित्युत॥
en: Arjuna, the foremost of car-warrior said to Dhrishtadyumna; Let, O Prince of the Panchalas, Shikhandin, that foremost of men be placed face to face with Bhishma. I myself will be his protector, O Prince.

sa: दीप्तजिह्वो महादंष्ट्रस्तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो महाबलः। व्यचरन् दण्डकारण्यं मांसभक्षो महामृगः॥ अग्निहोत्रेषु तीर्थेषु चैत्यवृक्षेषु रावण। अत्यन्तघोरो व्यचरंस्तापसांस्तान् प्रधर्षयन्॥ निहत्य दण्डकारण्ये तापमान् धर्मचारिणः। रुधिराणि पिबंस्तेषां तन्मासानि च भक्षयन्॥
en: I had a flaming tongue, huge teeth, sharpened horns and lived on the flesh of ascetics. Assuming such a terrible appearance I began to traverse with great vehemence the Tīrtha, Agnihotri and the place of worship; eating the flesh and drinking the blood of the ascetics after killing them I began to hinder all religious services.

sa: तत उत्थाय कौन्तयो भीमसेनो महाबलः। आजगाम महाबाहुर्मातुरन्तिकमञ्जसा॥
en: The powerful Bhima, the son of Kunti, being thus arisen, ran to his mother with all speed.

sa: उवाचैनं स्मितं कृत्वा रुद्रं शूलधरं हरिः। दैवतैर्मथ्यमाने तु यत्पूर्वं समुपस्थितम्॥ तत् त्वदीयं सुरश्रेष्ठ सुराणामग्रतो हि यत्। अग्रपूजागिह स्थित्वा गृहाणेदं विषं प्रभो॥
en: Smiling Hari said to the trident-bearing Rudra, 'O chief of the celestials, since you are the foremost of the gods, this that has come out of the ocean churned by the celestials, in your as Remaining here, O lord, do you receive the first offering in the form of this poison.'

sa: अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ॥
en: The son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, blew the conch called Anantavijaya, Nakula and Sahadeva blew Sughosha and Manipushpaka.

sa: केचिद्विनिहताः कृत्ताश्चेष्टन्ति स्म महीतले। वाहनेष्ववसक्ताश्च स्थिता एवपारे रणे॥ रथानागान्खराष्ट्रान्पन्नगांस्तुरगांस्तथा। शिशुमारान्वराहांश्च पिशाचवदनानपि॥ तान्समालिङ्गय बाहुभ्यां विष्टब्धाः केचिदुत्थिताः। देवैस्तु शस्त्रसंभिन्ना मनिरे च निशाचराः॥ चित्रकर्म इवाभाति सर्वेषां रणसंप्लवः। निहतानां प्रसुप्तानां राक्षसानां महीबले॥
en: Some fell down on earth of their carriers in the battle. And they all stood there in a halfsensible mood, some holding the car, some elephants, some asses, some boars, some Piśācamouthed animals and some embracing the Pannagas. And other night-rangers, having their bodies sundered by the deities gave up their being. The Rakşasas being slain and lying down on earth the action appeared wondrous like a painting.

sa: न किंचिन्मम कर्तव्यं तवान्यत्राभिषेचनात्। अतो यत्त्वामहं ब्रूयां तन्मे त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि॥ अद्य प्रकृतयः सर्वास्त्वामिच्छन्ति नराधिपम्। अतस्त्वां युवराजानमभिषेक्ष्यामि पुत्रक॥ अपि चाद्याशुभान् राम स्वप्नान् पश्यामि राघव। सनिर्घाता दिवोल्काश्च पतन्ति हि महास्वनाः॥
en: And naught now remain to be done by me save the installation. Therefore it behoves you to do even what I say to you. To-day the subjects in a body have expressed their desire of having you for their sovereign. Therefore, O son, I shall install you as the heir-apparent. O Rāghava, tonight I have dreamt inauspicious dreams. Stars with tremendous sounds, shoot by day, accompanied with thunder-claps.

sa: विशुद्धभावस्य हि दुष्टभावा दीनस्य ताम्राश्रुकलस्य राज्ञः। श्रुत्वा विचित्रं करुणं विलापं भर्तुर्नुशंसा न चकार वाक्यम्॥
en: Having heard the exceedingly piteous words of her husband, the king of pure sentiment, who was distressed, with his eye rendered coppery and flowing with tears, that wicked minded and merciless woman spoke not.

sa: स तच्छ्रुत्वा आरुणिरुपाध्यायवाक्यं तस्मात् केदारखण्डात् सहसोत्याय तमुपाध्यायमुपतस्थे॥
