en: Having heard the voice of his preceptor, Aruni rose speedily from the breach and stood before him.

sa: अथ दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णमुपस्थितम्। तूर्णमुत्थाय संहृष्टाः संनिकर्षमुपानयत्॥
en: Seeing Kumbhakarņa come, the Ten necked one, exceedingly rejoiced, raised him up and drew him near himself.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा कैकेयीं संयताञ्जलिः॥ प्रसादयामास पुनः कैकेयी राजधर्मवित्।
en: Having spoken thus, the kind conversant with the duties of Sovereigns again endeavoured to propitiate Kaikeyī, saying.

sa: पूर्वैरनुगतो मार्गो देवैरसुरघातिभिः। सद्धिश्चानुगतः पन्थाः स सर्वैरनुगम्यते॥
en: The gods themselves, in killing the Asuras, have followed by the celestials, may be followed by all.

sa: ऋत्विजौ द्वावभिमतौ तस्यास्तामृषिसत्तमौ। वसिष्ठो वामदेवश्च मन्त्रिणश्च तथापरे॥
en: And he had two family priests beloved to him; viz., those foremost of saints. Vasistha and Vamadeva.

sa: ततो गत्वा केशवस्तं ददर्श रामं वने स्थितमेकं विविक्ते॥ अथापश्यद् योगयुक्तस्य तस्य नागं मुखान्निश्चरन्तं महान्तम्।
en: Proceeding then to the forest, Keshava saw Rama sitting in a solitary place. He also saw that Rama had set himself to Yoga and that from out his mouth was issuing a powerful snake.

sa: जुहुवुस्ते सुतपसो विधिवज्जातवेदसम्। मन्त्रैरुच्चावचैर्विप्रा येन कामेन तच्छृणु॥
en: Hear, Sir, desiring what these excellent Rishi's poured ghee in the sacrificial fire loudly reciting Mantras, saying,

sa: अस्मिन्नर्थे पुरा गीता श्रूयन्ते धर्मचिन्तकैः॥ श्लोका न्यायमवेक्षद्भिस्तत्त्वार्थास्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः।
en: Regarding this matter, certain ancient verses, full of truth, are heard, sung by truthseeing and righteous persons.

sa: स निर्ययौ जनौघेन महता केकयाधिपः। त्वरमाणोऽभिचक्राम गन्धर्वान्केकयाधिपः।२।।
en: He, the king of Kekaya, with a huge army they speedily went out for conquering the Gandharvas.

sa: ऋषयोऽन्तर्हिता जग्मुस्ततस्ते नारदादयः। तस्मिन् कोलाहले वृत्ते तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Then did those Rishis, Narada and others vanished from sight, lost in the confusion, which followed that.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्या नर्तनागाररक्षिणः। सहसैव समाजग्मुरादायोल्काः सहस्रशः॥
en: He who desired for another's wife; come and see.” Hearing her words the guards of the assembly-hall.

sa: किमुक्तेन व्यतीतेन भीमसेन महाबल। प्रत्युपस्थितकालस्य कार्यस्यानन्तरो भव॥
en: O Bhimsena, what is the use of dwelling on what is passed. Be ready for the present.

sa: शिबिसौवीरसिन्धूनां विषादश्चाप्यजायत। तान् दृष्ट्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रान् व्याघ्रानिव बलोत्कटान्॥
en: Seeing those powerful heroes like dreadful tigers the heroes of Shibi, Sauvira and Sindhu tribes lost heart.

sa: वायुरुवाच भो भो राघव सत्यं वै वायुरस्मि सदागतिः। अपापा मैथिली राजन् संगच्छ सह भार्यया॥
en: Vayu said: O descendant of Raghu, (what Sita has said) is true. I am the wind (god) and ever in motion. O king, the princess of Mithila is pure. Be united with your wife.

sa: प्राप्नोति वै चित्तमसद्वलेन नित्योत्थानात् प्रज्ञया पौरुषेण। न त्वेव सम्यग् लभते प्रशंसा न वृत्तमाप्नोति महाकुलानाम्॥
en: An unrighteous man obtains wealth by force, by incessant efforts, by intelligence and by prowess; but he does not win fame, properly so called, nor the wealth (virtues) of those born in high families.

sa: अभिमन्युं च बीभत्सुरानिनाय जनार्दनम्। आनर्तेभ्योऽपि दाशार्हानानयामास पाण्डवः॥
en: Bibhatsu then brought over Abhimanyu, Janardana and many members of the Dasharha family from the Anarta country.

sa: सोऽवतीर्य स्थात् तूर्णमभिवाद्य जनार्दनः। यथावृत्तानृषीन् सर्वानभ्यभाषत पूजयन्॥
en: Then Janardana quickly step down from his chariot, and said all those Rishis with adoration and respect.

sa: शुभानुशयबुद्धिर्हि संयुक्तः कालधर्मणा। प्रादुर्भवति तद्योगात् कल्याणमतिरेव सः॥
en: A man whose mind follows good after death is born on that account possessing a virtuous mind.

sa: यक्ष उवाच व्याख्याता मे त्वया प्रश्ना याथातथ्यं परंतप। पुरुषं त्विदानी व्याख्याहि यश्च सर्वधनी नरः॥
en: The Yaksha said: O tormentor of foes, you have rightly answered all my questions. Now relate to me who can be called a man and what man is enriched with all sorts of wealth.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यत् तुभ्यं रोचते कृष्ण स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि कौरवान्। कृतार्थं स्वस्तिमन्तं त्वां द्रक्ष्यामि पुनरागतम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said As you please, O Krishna. May all that is good come out of it. Go to the sons of Kuru. May I see you return with your object gained and in health.

sa: सुदेष्णोवाच कस्त्वावधीद् वरारोहे कस्माद् रोदिषि शोभने। कस्याद्य न सुखं भद्रे केन ते विप्रियं कृतम्॥
en: Sudeshana said O beautiful one of excellent hips, who has slighted you, why do you weep. O gentle one, whose happiness will come to an end this day? Who has done wrong to you?

sa: क्षयोदयोऽयं सुमहान् कुरूणां प्रत्युपस्थितः। अस्त चेत् कलहस्यान्तः शमादन्यो न विद्यते॥ शमो मे रोचते नित्यं पार्थस्तात न विग्रहः। कुरुभ्यो हि सदा मन्ये पाण्डवान् शक्तिमत्तरान्॥
en: A great cause of the destruction of the Kurus is now come. If there is no other means of an end to this quarrel, than peace, peace seems desirable to me and not war with the sons of Pritha. I have ever been of opinion that the Pandavas are possessed of greater strength than the Kurus.

sa: दिव्यास्त्वामुपभोगाश्च मत्प्रसादकृताः सदा॥ उपस्थास्यन्ति हनुमन्निति स्म हरिलोचन।
en: And through my favour, O yellow-eyed Hanuman, celestials dishes and drinks will over be within your reach.

sa: प्राची राजा दक्षिणां भीमसेनो जयः प्रतीची यमजावुदीचीम्। मन्ये त तेषां रथसत्तमानां कालोऽभितः प्राप्त इहोपयातुम्॥
en: The king has gone to the east, Bhimasena towards the south, Arjuna to the west and the twin brothers towards the north. Me-thinks, the time of the arrival of those leading carwarriors, has come.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। यथा निर्बन्धतः प्राप्तो गालवेन पराजयः॥
en: In this connection is cited the old story in which out of obstinacy Galava met with defeat.

sa: कर्ण उवाच दुर्योधन निबोधेदं यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि कौरव। श्रुत्वा वाचं तथा सर्वं कर्तुमर्हस्यरिंदम॥ तवाद्य पृथिवी वीर नि:सपत्ना नृपोत्तम। तां पालय यथा शक्रो हतशत्रुर्महामनाः॥
en: "O descendant of Kuru, O Duryodhana, lay into your heart the words that I shall tell you. O chastiser of foes, after having heard my words, you should act accordingly. O foremost of kings, O hero, the earth has been now got rid of all our enemies. Now rule over the earth like the illustrious Indra."

sa: तस्मात् सत्रं प्रविष्टेषु पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु। गूढभावेषु छन्नेषु काले चोदयमागते॥ स्वराष्ट्र परराष्ट्रे च ज्ञातव्यं बलमात्मनः। उदयः पाण्डवानां च प्राप्ते काले न संशयः॥
en: When the time for the return of the highsoul Pandavas comes, who are now passing their days in close disguise in woods you should gauge your own strength in your own kingdom and in those of other kings. Forsooth, the time of the return of the Pandavas is near at hand.

sa: अमानुषाणां भूतानां तेषां च ध्वजवासिनाम्। ऊर्ध्वं पुच्छान् विधुन्वाना रेभमाणाः समन्ततः। गावः प्रतिन्यवर्तन्त दिशमास्थाय दक्षिणाम्॥
en: As well as with the cries of all the superhuman creatures placed on the flag staff. Then raising up their tails and running to and fro the king came back by the southern road.

sa: भूयो भूयो हि यद् राजन् पृच्छसे पाण्डवान् प्रति। सारासारबलं ज्ञातुं तत् समासेन मे शृणु॥
en: Again and again, have you, O king, asked me about the Pandavas with a view to know their strength and the points of their superiority and inferiority. Listen to that from me in brief:

sa: न दुःखं राज्यहरणं न च द्यूते पराजयः। प्रव्राजनं तु पुत्राणां न मे तद् दुःखकारणम्॥
en: The loss of kingdom is not a source of trouble, not even the defeat at the game of dice; nor even the exile of my sons was so much the cause of my affliction;

sa: सर्वे कालस्य वेत्तारः कृच्छ्ररूपधराः स्थिताः। प्रविशेयुर्जितक्रोधास्तावदेव पुनर्वनम्॥
en: Let them, with anger controlled, acquainted with all seasons, living in painful disguise, enter the woods again.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शल्यः श्रुत्वा तु दूतानां सैन्येन महता वृतः। अभ्ययात् पाण्डवान् राजन् सह पुत्रैर्महारथैः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Shalya, having heard the news of hostility between the two parties, went to help the Pandavas, O king, surrounded by a large army and by his friends who were mighty in battle.

sa: सहदेव उवाच पञ्चानां पाण्डुपुत्राणां ज्येष्ठो भ्राता युधिष्ठिरः। तस्याष्टशतसाहस्रा गवां वर्गाः शतं शतम्॥ अपरे शतसाहस्रा विस्तावन्तस्तथा परे। तेषां गोसंख्य आसं वै तन्तिपालेति मां विदुः॥
en: Sahadeva said Of the five sons of Pandu Yudhishthira is the eldest. He had one division of kine the number where of amounts to eight hundred and ten thousand and another ten thousand, and another twenty thousand and so forth. I was employed as an enumerator of cows under them; people used to call me Tantipala.

sa: वनं राजा धृतराष्ट्रः सपुत्रो व्याघ्रास्ते वै संजय पाण्डुपुत्राः॥ मा वनं छिन्धि सव्यानं मा व्याघ्राऽनीनशन्वनात्॥
en: The king Dhritarashtra with his sons in the forest and the sons of Pandu, O Sanjaya, the tigers. The forest with the tigers cannot be cut down ner the tigers in the forest destroyed.

sa: लक्ष्मणस्तु सुसंक्रुद्धो निःश्वसन् वाक्यमब्रवीत्। केनायमपराधेन राजपुत्रो विवासितः॥
en: Thereupon Lakşmaņa waxing wroth, breathing hard, said, For what fault of his has the Prince been banished?

sa: एवं वदन्तस्ते सोढुं न शेकुर्बाष्पमागतम्। नरास्तमनुगच्छन्ति प्रियमिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनम्॥
en: Saying this; they could not suppress their fears; and the men followed the beloved descendant of Ikşvāku.

sa: लक्ष्मणश्च सुमन्त्रश्च बाढमित्येव राघवम्। उक्त्वा तमिङ्गुदीवृक्षं तदोपययतुर्हयैः॥
en: Thereupon saying to Rāghava, “Very well,” Lakşinana and Sumantra with the horses went to the Ingudi tree.

sa: तामुपस्थापितां दृष्ट्वा शिबिकां वानराधिपः॥ लक्ष्मणारुह्यतां शीघ्रमिति सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्।
en: Seeing the car brought up, the lord of monkeys said to Sumitra's son, O Laksmana, ascend speedily.

sa: विधूय शोकं परिहृष्टमानसा महर्षियाते पथि सुव्यवस्थिताः। वने रता वन्यफलाशनाः पितुः शुभां प्रतिज्ञा प्रतिपालयन्ति ते॥
en: Renouncing grief and with cheerful hearts, well established in the life led by the Maharşis, they living in the forest on wild fruits as their sustenance, are maintaining the noble promise of their sire.

sa: गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषं श्रुत्वा शुभसमन्विता। कथं क्रव्यादसिंहानां शब्दं श्रोष्यत्यशोभनम्॥
en: Having heard excellent vocal and instrumental music, how will Sītă hear the frightful cries of carnivorous lions?

sa: कथमस्मद्विधे शस्त्रं निपतेच्च तपस्विनी। प्रविविक्तां नदी रात्रावुदाहारोऽहमागतः॥
en: Why does the weapon light upon me? I had come to this lone stream for procuring water.

sa: कृत्वा च समयं रामः सुग्रीवेण सहानघः। कालयुक्तं महद्वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनः॥ विनीतं भ्रातरं भ्राता लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम्।
en: Making the above condition with Sugrīva, Rāma, the pure-souled descendant of Raghu, spoke to his humble younger brother Lakşmaņa, the enhance of wealth, the following sound words, worthy of being spoken on that occasion.

sa: देवगन्धर्वसंकाशास्तत्र ते न्यवसन् सुखम्। चित्रकूटं गते रामे पुत्रशोकातुरस्तदा॥ राजा दशरथः स्वर्ग जगाम विलपन् सुतम्।
en: They spent their days in delight, in the company of gods and Gandharvas. And when Rāma had reached the Citrakuța, king Dasaratha, distressed on account of his son, went to heaven, bewailing the latter.

sa: ततस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञाताः प्रसन्नेन महात्मना॥ ताम्रपर्णी ग्राहजुष्टां तरिष्यथ महानदीम्।
en: Permitted by that gratified high-souled one, you will cross over the great river, Tăniraparni, abounding in alligators.

sa: तमतिक्रम्य लक्ष्मीवान् समुद्रे शतयोजने। गिरिः पुष्पितको नाम सिद्धचारणसेवितः॥ चन्द्रसूर्यांशुसंकाशः सागराम्बुसमाश्रयः। भ्राजते विपुलैः शृङ्गैरम्बरं विलिखन्निव॥ तस्यैकं काञ्चनं शृङ्ग सेवते यं दिवाकरः। न तं कृतघ्नाः पश्यन्ति न नृशंसा न नास्तिकाः॥
en: In the sea extending over an hundred Yojanas, a lovely hill, named Puspitaka, the abode of Siddhas and Chăraņas; resembling the rays of the sun or the moon,-resting on the waters of the ocean, looks splendid, piercing the heavens with its giant peaks. Of this (mountain), there is a particular golden summit, which the sun approaches. It is incapable of being beheld by the ungrateful or the atheistical.

sa: न किंचिदाहाहितमप्रियं वचो नवेत्ति रामः परुषाणि भाषितुम्। कथं तु रामे ह्यभिरामवादिनि ब्रवीषि दोषान् गुणनित्यसम्मते॥
en: Rāma has not used any harsh speech towards you. Indeed Rāma knows no harsh speech; why then do you seek to inflict upon Rāma (ever) pleasant spoken, and endowed with agreeable qualities, such wrongs.

sa: यदा यदा च कौसल्या दासीव च सखीव च॥ भार्यावद् भगिनीवच्च मातृवच्चोपतिष्ठति। सततं प्रियकामा मे प्रियपुत्रा प्रियंवदा॥ न मया सत्कृता देवी सत्कारार्हा कृते तव।
en: Kausalyă serves me at the same time like a slave, and a friend, and wife, and sister, and mother. Ever studious of my welfare, dearly loving her son, and speaking every one fair, that exalted lady, although deserving of homage at my hands, has up to this time not been regarded by me, because of you.

sa: एवमाश्वासयन्नेव दुःखार्तोऽनुपपात ह। विहीनां पतिपुत्राभ्यां कौसल्या पार्थिवात्मजः॥
en: Having thus consoled Kausalyā bereft of her son and husband, the prince afflicted with distress fell down.

sa: तैर्वाक्यैः परुषैर्दुःखैः कैकेयी भृशदुःखिता। शत्रुघ्नभयसंत्रस्ता पुत्रं शरणमागता॥
en: Extremely hurt by those rough words, Kaikeyi terrified on account of Satrughna, took refuge with her son.

sa: एवमुक्ता तदा देव्या मन्थरा पापदर्शिनी। रामार्थमुपहिंसन्ती कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus addressed by the worshipful one, the wicked minded Mantharā, envying Rāma's interest, thus spoke to Kaikeyi.

sa: सुषेणदुहिता चेयमर्थसूक्ष्मविनिश्चये। औत्पातिके च विविधे सर्वतः परिनिष्ठिता॥
en: Surasen's daughter is wonderfully expert in ascertaining sabtle things and giving counsels in the time of danger.

sa: प्रसाद्यमानः शिरसा मया स्वयं बहुप्रकारं यदि न प्रपत्स्यत। ततोऽनुवत्स्यामि चिराय राघवं वनेचरं नार्हति मामुपेक्षितुम्॥
en: Propitiated by me personally in various ways with bent head, if he do not consent, then shall I ever stay with Rāghava in the woods. Surely he cannot long persist in putting me off.

sa: तमृषिः पुरुषव्याघ्र प्रेक्ष्य प्राञ्जलिमागतम्। हुताग्निहोत्रो भरतं भरद्वाजोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Seeing that foremost of men (standing) with joined hands, Bharadvāja, who had just finished his fire-sacrifice, said.

sa: अङ्गदप्रतिरूपाणां पुत्राणामेकतः शतम्। हतस्याप्यस्य वीरस्य गात्रसंश्लेषणं वरम्॥
en: I would rather die with this hero who has been slain than have hundred sons like Angada.

sa: स तत् प्रकर्षन् हरिणां महद्बलं बभूव वीरः पवनात्मजः कपिः। गताम्बुदे व्योम्नि विशुद्धमण्डलः शशीव नक्षत्रगणोपशोभितः॥
en: Then taking with him that mighty host of monkeys, that hero, the son of the wind, resembled the moon of bright disc in the sky, garnished by the stars, after the clouds have departed.

sa: ते वनेन वनं गत्वा नदीस्तीर्वा बहूदकाः॥ चित्रकूटमनुप्राप्य भरद्वाजस्य शासनात्। रम्यमावसथं कृत्वा रममाणा वने त्रयः॥
en: Then wending from one forest to another, and having crossed many broad rivers, they, in accordance with Bharadvăja's directions, arrived at the Citrakūta; and constructing a romantic abode, the three began to live there.

sa: कच्चिद् दशरथो राजा कुशली सत्यसंगरः। राजसूयाश्वमेधानामाहर्ता धर्मनिश्चितः॥
en: Is that truthful one, that performer of Rajasüya and Aśvamedha, ever devoted to righteousness, king Dasaratha, well?

sa: ततो राजा विदेहानां वसिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत्। कारयस्व ऋषे सर्वामृषिभिः सह धार्मिक॥ रामस्य लोकरामस्य क्रियां वैवाहिकी प्रभो।
en: Then to the king of the Videhas, Vasiştha spoke as follows, O saint, do you, O pious one, in company with the saints, perform, O master, the nuptial ceremonies of Rāma charming to all.

sa: न ते कश्चिद् दशरथस्त्वं च तस्य न कश्चन। अन्यो राजा त्वमन्यस्तु तस्मात् कुरु यदुच्यते॥
en: Dasaratha is none to you, and you too are none's to Dasaratha. He is quite other than your sire; and you have no connection with him. Therefore, do you act as I tell you.

sa: तस्यास्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः। आर्जवेन यथातत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Hearing her words, Hanumān, the son of the wind-god, in all candour began to relate everything faithfully.

sa: यत्कृते पितरः पुत्राञ्जनयन्ति शुभार्थिनः। परलोकहितार्थाय तस्य कालोऽयमागतः॥
en: That in view of which fathers beget wellwishing sons, the compassing of other's welfare is at hand.

sa: अंशुमानपि पुत्रोऽभूदसमञ्जस्य वीर्यवान्। दिलीपोंऽशुमतः पुत्रो दिलीपस्य भगीरथः॥
en: Asamanja's son was the puissant Ansumat. Dilipa is the son of Ansumat and Dilipa's son is Bhagiratha.

sa: कामाद् वा तात लोभाद् वा मात्रा तुभ्यमिदं कृतम्। न तन्मनसि कर्तव्यं वर्तितव्यं च मातृवत्॥
en: My brother, you ought not to cherish in your mind what your mother incited by covetousness or affection for you has done; and you should act by her as one should by one's mother.

sa: सर्वमासीत् सुसंतुष्टं हृष्टपुष्टजनायुतम्। विश्वामित्रबलं राम वसिष्ठेन सुतर्पितम्॥
en: And, O Rāma, the tarry of Viśvāmitra being superbly entertained by Vasiştha, heartily filled, became exceedingly gratified.

sa: ततो रामो धनुष्पाणिस्तावुभौ समुदैक्षत। अन्योन्यसदृशौ वीराबुभौ देवाविवाश्विनौ॥
en: Thereupon Rāma, with bow in hand, beheld those two heroes resembling each other, like to two Aświns.

sa: महर्षिस्तमनादृत्य प्रविवेशाश्रमं प्रति। शापधारणभीतस्तु वाली विह्वलतां गतः॥
en: Disregarding him, the ascetic entered into his asylum and Vāli was overwhelmed with the fear of curse.

sa: क्व सीता केन वा दृष्टा को वा हरति मैथिलीम्। तदाख्यातुं भवान् सर्वं गतिर्भव वनौकसाम्॥
en: Where is Sītā? By whom has she been seen? And who has carried away Mithila's daughter? Do you tell us all about this, and (thus) prove the path of these rangers of the woods.

sa: तत्रैवाप्सरसः पञ्च निवसन्त्यो यथासुखम्। रमयन्ति तपोयोगान्मुनिं यौवनमास्थितम्॥
en: And there the five nymphs living happily, pleased the anchorite, established in youth through asceticism and yoga.

sa: स प्रविश्याश्रमपदं लक्ष्मणो राघवानुजः। अगस्त्यशिष्यमासाद्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥
en: Having entered the asylum, Räghava's younger brother, Lakşmana, coming to a disciple of Agastya, spoke to him.

sa: सुखार्हस्य महार्हस्य सर्वभूतहितात्मनः। श्वर्येण विह, नस्य वनवासे रतस्य च॥ रक्षसापहृता भार्या रहिते कामरूपिणा। तच्च न ज्ञायते रक्षः पत्नी येनास्य वा हृता॥
en: Worthy of happiness, homage, and intent upon the welfare of all beings, deprived of wealth and living in the forest, he has his wife carried off by a Rākşasa, wearing shapes at will. Nor have we yet (been able) to ascertain who is that Rākşasa that has carried off his wife.

sa: उक्तवाक्यं महाप्राज्ञं जाम्बवन्तं महाकपिः। प्रत्युवाचोत्तरं वाक्यं वालिसूनुरथाङ्गदः॥
en: Threat that mighty monkey, Angada, son to Vali, answered the exceedingly wise Jambavan, when he had spoken,

sa: तानि दिव्यानि भद्रं ते ददाम्यस्त्राणि सर्वशः। दण्डचक्रं महद् दिव्यं तव दास्यामि राघव॥ धर्मचक्रं ततो वीर कालचक्रं तथैव च। विष्णुचक्रं तथात्युग्रमैन्द्रं चक्रं तथैव च॥
en: All those celestial weapons, good betide you, I will confer upon you. And I will confer upon you, O Rāghava, the celestial and mighty Dandacakra,* and Dharmacakra, and also Kalacakra. And, ) foremost of men, I will confer upon you the fierce Vişnucakra, and Indracakra. *Cakra means discus. These enumerations specify different kinds of the discus.

sa: वानरांश्च महाकायान् प्रेषयिष्यति राघव॥ दिशो विचेतुं तां सीतां त्वद्वियोगेन शोचतीम्। अन्वेष्यति वरारोहां मैथिली रावणालये॥
en: He shall search that exquisitely fine damsel Maithili in Ravana's abode, bewailing on your separation, and to find her out he shall despatch, O Rāghava, many a monkey of huge proportions to various quarters.

sa: विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः॥ एकं सहस्रैर्बहुभिस्तदा दृष्ट्वा समावृतम्।
en: And seeing him single, surrounded by many thousand, the Gods, Gandharvas, Siddhas, and supreme saints became sorrowful.

sa: तद् बभूव शितैर्बाणैः खररामविसर्जितैः। पर्याकाशमनाकाशं सर्वतः शरसंकुलम्॥
en: With the sharpened shafts shot by Khara and Rāma, the entire firmament on all sides was thronged.

sa: ऋषयश्च महात्मानः सिद्धविद्याधरोरगाः। चारणाश्च सुतान् वीरान् ससृजुर्वनचारिणः॥
en: And high-souled ascetics, and Siddhas, and Vidyādharas, and Uragas, and Caranas, generated heroic sons, rangers of woods.

sa: तमेवं वानरश्रेष्ठं गर्जन्तममितप्रभम्॥ प्रहृष्टा हरयस्तत्र समुदैक्षन्त विस्मिताः।
en: Filled with delight, the monkeys there amazed see that foremost of monkeys, endued with immeasurable might, storming.

sa: तदासाद्य दशग्रीवः क्षिप्रमन्तरमास्थितः। अभिचक्राम वैदेही परिव्राजकरूपधृक् ॥
en: Thereupon the ten-necked one, availing of this opportunity came before Vaidehī assuming the semblance of a mendicant.

sa: शैररावारितस्तस्य संयुगे पतगेश्वरः। कुलायमभिसम्प्राप्तः पक्षिवच्च बभौ तदा॥
en: Being covered with those arrows, the lord of birds appeared like a bird lying in his nest.

sa: सम्परिष्वज्य वैदेही वामेनाङ्केन रावणः। तलेनाभिजघाना” जटायुं क्रोधमूछितः॥
en: Beside himself with anger, Ravana, holding Jānaki fast by her left flank, struck Jațāyu with his palms.

sa: तां महोल्कामिवाकाशे दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा। जहाराकाशमाविश्य सीतां वैश्रवणानुजः॥
en: Vaisravana's younger brother carried away Sītā, who, like a mighty meteor, filled the heavens with her splendour.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा पाणिना शैलमालभ्य हरिपुङ्गवः। जगामाकाशमाविश्य वीर्यवान् प्रसहनिव॥
en: Thereupon touching the hill with his hand that highly energetic monkey wended, smiling his aerial way. Ocean

sa: ततः सुग्रीववचनाद्धत्वा बालिनमाहवे। सुग्रीवमेव तद्राज्ये राघवः प्रत्यपादयत्॥
en: And, in compliance with Sugrīva's request, having slain Vālī in battle, Raghava conferred the kingdom on Sugriva.

sa: तस्य संत्वरमाणस्य द्रष्टुकामस्य मैथिलीम्। क्रूरस्वनोऽथ गोमायुर्विननादास्य पृष्ठतः॥
en: And as he hurried himself, eager to behold Maithilī, jackals began to howl hideously at his back.

sa: पद्भयामेव जगामाथ ससीतः सहलक्ष्मणः। संनिकृष्टपदन्यासो रामो वनपरायणः॥
en: Along with Lakşmaņa and Sitā, Rāma bound for the forest, began to walk near them on foot.

sa: अथ रात्र्यां प्रपन्नायां कालरात्र्यामिवात्मनः। अर्धरात्रे दशरथः कौसल्यामिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then when the night had come like to his own fatal night, Dasaratha at mid-night addressed Kausalyā.

sa: अहं तु पुत्रो भगवन् पिता राजा गुरुश्च मे। निदेशवर्ती च पितुः पुत्रो भवति धर्मतः॥
en: I am your son. You, O holy one, are my father! You are our king, and you are our preceptor! The son should as dictated by every duty, obey the commands of his father.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच अलिङ्गो निर्गुणश्चैव कारणं नास्य लक्ष्यते। उपायमेव वक्ष्यामि येन गृह्येत वा न वा॥
en: The Brahmana said He is without symbols, and without qualities. Nothing exists that may be you the considered as his cause. I shall, however, tell means by which he can be apprehended or not.

sa: शक्र उवाच केन शम्बर वृत्तेन स्वजात्यानधितिष्ठसि। श्रेष्ठं त्वां केन मन्यन्ते तद् वै प्रब्रूहि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Shakra said Through what conduct, O Shambara, you have been able to become the head of your family? Why do all people consider you as superior? Do you tell me this truly and fully.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। मतङ्गस्य व संवादं गर्दभ्याश्च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Regarding it is cited an old history, O Yudhishthira, of a conversation between Matanga and a she-ass.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। इन्द्रियाणां च संवादं मनसश्चैव भामिनि॥
en: Regarding it is cited, O beautiful lady, this ancient discourse between the senses and the mind. never

sa: सम्मोहोऽज्ञानमत्यागः कर्मणामविनिर्णयः। स्वप्नः स्तम्भो भयं लोभः स्वतः सुकृतदूषणम्॥ अस्मृतिश्चाविपाकश्च नास्तिक्यं भिन्नवृत्तिता। निर्विशेषत्वमन्धत्वं जघन्यगुणवृत्तिता॥ अकृते कृतमानित्वमज्ञाने ज्ञानमानिता। अमैत्री विकृताभावो ह्यश्रद्धा मूढभावना॥ अनार्जवमसंज्ञत्वं कर्म पापचेतना। गुरुत्वं सन्नभावत्वमवशित्वमवाग्गतिः॥ सर्व एते गुणा वृत्तास्तामसाः सम्प्रकीर्तिताः। ये चान्ये विहिता भावा लोकेऽस्मिन् भावसंज्ञिताः।। तत्र तत्र नियम्यन्ते सर्वे ते तामसा गुणाः। परिवादकथा नित्यं देवब्राह्मणवैदिकी॥ अत्यागश्चाभ
en: Complete delusion, Ignorance, illiberality, indecision about action, sleep, haughtiness, fcar, cupidity, grief, censure of good deeds, loss of meinory, unripeness of judgeinent, absence of faith, violation of all rules of conduct, want of discrimination, blindness, vileness of conduct, boastful assertion of performance when there has been performance, presumption of knowledge in ignorance, unfriendliness (or hostility), evilness of disposition, absence of faith, stupid reasoning, crookedness, incapacity for association, sinfull action, senselessness, stolidity, assitude, absence of self-control, degradation, all these qualities are known as no belonging to Ignorance. Whatever other states of mid, connected with delusion, exist in the world, all belong to Ignorance, Frequent illspeaking of

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच स्त्रीणां स्वभावमिच्छामि श्रोतुं भरतसत्तम। स्त्रियो हि मूलं दोषाणां लघुचित्ता हि ताः स्मृताः॥१
en: Yudhishthira said O best of the Bharatas, I wish to hear you describe the disposition of women. Women are said to be the root of all evil. They are all considered as highly frail.

sa: दिवि वा भुवि वा देव सर्वे हि विदितं तव। साधयाम वयं कृष्ण बुद्धिं पृष्टिमवाप्नुहि॥
en: You know whatever is on Earth, and whatever is in the celestial region. We take our leave of You, O Krishna, for returning to our respective quarters. May You increase in intelligence and prosperity.

sa: कुन्तीसमीपे पुरुषोत्तमौ तु यमाविमौ विष्णुमहेन्द्रकल्पौ। मनुष्यलोके सकले समोऽस्ति ययोर्न रूपे न बले न शीले॥
en: Those two foremost of men, who are sitting beside Kunti, are the twins resembling Vishnu and Mahendra. In the entire world, they have not their cquals in beauty and strength and excellence of conduct.

sa: पृथग्भूतं ततः सत्त्वमित्येतदविचारितम्। पृथग्भावश्च विज्ञेयः सहजश्चापि तत्त्वतः॥
en: If it said that Nature is different from Purusha, that also will indicate a want of consideration.

sa: कश्यप उवाच सर्वत्र सर्वं लपतु न्यासलोपं करोतु च। कूटसाक्षित्वमभ्येतु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः॥ वृथामांसाशनश्चास्तु वृथादानं करोतु च। यातु स्त्रियं दिवा चैव बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः॥
en: Kashyapa said Let him who has stolen the lotusstalks give vent to all sorts of words in all places, give false evidence in a court of law, eat the flesh of animals not killed in sacrifices, make gifts to unworthy persons or to worthy persons at unseasonable times, and have sexual connection with women during daytime.

sa: कुबेरनलिनी रम्यां राक्षसैरभिसेविताम्। पद्भिरेव गमिष्यामस्तप्यमाना महत् तपः॥
en: Practising great asceticism, we shall go walking to the charming lake of Kubera guarded by the Rakshashas.

sa: श्राद्धं दत्त्वा च भुक्त्वा च पुरुषो यःस्त्रियं व्रजेत्। पितरस्तस्य तं मासं तस्मिन् रेतसि शेरते।॥
en: The departed Manes of that man who indulges in sexual intercourse on the day he performs a Shraddha or eats at a Shraddha, have to lie for a whole month on his vital seed.

sa: तदा तत्प्रतिकाराच्च सततं चाविचिन्तनात्। आधिव्याधिप्रशमनं क्रियायोगद्वयेन तु॥
en: Disease may be allayed by the application of medicine, but mental ailments, are cured by Yoga meditation.

sa: नान्यत्र बुद्धिक्षान्तिभ्यां नान्यत्रेन्द्रियनिग्रहात्। नान्यत्र धनसंत्यागाद् गणः प्राज्ञेऽवतिष्ठते॥
en: Nothing but intelligence and forgiveness, control of the senses, and liberality, reside in a person of wisdom.

sa: सोऽहं कितवमातेव द्वयोरपि महामते। एकस्य जयमाशंसे द्वितीयस्यापराजयम्॥
en: I am like the mother of two brothers gambling against each other, praying for victory to both.

sa: ततोऽपवाहितं दृष्ट्वा वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम्॥ अब्रवीद् दुःखसंक्रुद्धो विश्वामित्रो ह्यमर्षणः।
en: Seeing that best of Rishis, viz., Vashishtha, borne away, the vindictive Vishvamitra becoming enraged addressed Sarasvati, saying

sa: मानसं शमयेत् तस्माज्ज्ञानेनाग्निमिवाम्बुना। प्रशान्ते मानसे ह्यस्य शारीरमुपशाम्यति॥
en: As water quenches fire, so knowledge allays mental ailments. When mind enjoys' peace, body also enjoys peace.

sa: तमब्रवीत् तदा कर्णः शृणु मे राजकुञ्जर। पादौ न धावये तावद् यावन्न निहतोऽर्जुनः॥ कीलालजं न खादेयं करिष्ये चासुरव्रतम्। नास्तीति नैव वक्ष्यामि याचितो येन केनचित्॥
en: Thereupon Karna said to the king, "O foremost of kings, hear what I say? As long I sons do not kill Arjuna, so long I shall not wash my feet. Nor shall I taste meat. I shall observe the Asura vow. Whoever will ask from me any thing, I shall never say “I have it not.”

sa: ततः सुदेवमानाय्य राजमाता विशाम्यते। पप्रच्छ भार्या कस्येयं सुता वा कस्य भाविनी॥ कथं च नष्टा ज्ञातिभ्यो भर्तुर्वा वामलोचना। त्वया च विदिता विप्र कथमेवगंता सती॥
en: O the ruler of the earth! the Queen-mother summoned Sudeva before her and asked him, saying, 'whose wife is this lady? and whose daughter? and how this damsel, possessing handsome eyes has been separated from her husband as well as her relatives? O Brahmana! how have you come to know her, falling in this great distress?

sa: वेद्यं सर्प परं ब्रह्म निर्दुःखमसुखं च यत्। यत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति भवतः किं विवक्षितम्॥
en: And, O serpent, that which ought to be . known is the Supreme Brahma (universal soul) devoid of the feelings of) pleasure and pain and attaining access to which creatures are past all misery.

sa: चकोरैरुपचक्रैश्च पक्षिभिर्जीवजीवकैः। कोकिलै ङ्गराजैश्च तत्र तत्र निनादितान्॥
en: Ringing here and there with the rejoicing of the Chakora, Upachakra, Jivajivaka, Kokila (cuckoo) and Bhringaraja birds,

sa: सौबलस्य वधं प्रेप्सुरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। क्रोधसंरक्तनयनो निःश्वसन्निव पन्नगः॥
en: And sighting like a snake and desiring to kill Shakuni, spoke thus with eyes red with anger.

sa: स वध्यमानस्तैरस्त्रैरर्जुनेन महात्मना। ततोऽस्यदर्शयामास तदाऽऽत्मानं प्रियः सखा।॥
en: Attacked by those weapons by the illustrious Arjuna, his dear friend the Gandharva king appeared before him.

sa: तत्र युद्धं महच्चासीच्छूरैर्मत्तमयूरकैः। मरुभूमि स कात्स्र्थेन तथैव बहुधान्यकम्॥ च प्रतस्थे शैरीषकं महोत्थं च वशे चक्रे महाद्युतिः। आक्रोशं चैव राजर्षि तेन युद्धमभून्महत्॥
en: The battle between him and the heroic Mattamayurakas was a great one. The greatly effulgent (hero) then conquered the desert country and then the country, called Shairishaka which was full of wealth and paddy, then also that country, called Mahottha. a great battle was then fought with the royal saga, Akrosha.

sa: अर्थास्तस्योपपत्स्यन्तेधन्यतां च गमिष्यति। इतिहासमिमं श्रुत्वा पुराणं शश्वदुत्तमम्॥
en: He, who hears this excellent and old history, gets all his desires fulfilled and obtains wealth and

sa: यदैव कालं पुरुषप्रवीरो वेत्स्यत्ययं माधव विक्रमस्य। तदा रणे त्वं च शिनिप्रवीर सुयोधनं जेष्यसि केशवश्च॥
en: O descendant of Madhu, O foremost of the Sinis, when this best of men (Krishna) will perceive that the proper time is come for displaying courage, you and he will then defeat Suyodhana (Duryodhana).

sa: सोऽवतीर्य रथोपस्थादृतुपर्णो नराधिपः। उपतस्थे महाराज भीमं भीमपराक्रमम्॥
en: Having alighted from the car, car, king Rituparna appeared before that excellent monarch, Bhima, of terrible prowess.

sa: स तानुवाचास्ति खलु राजर्षिरिन्द्रद्युम्नो नाम क्षीणपुण्यस्त्रिदिवात् प्रच्युतः कीर्तिस्ते व्युच्छिन्नेति स मामुपातिष्ठदथ प्रत्यभिजानाति मां भवानिति॥
en: He told them, “Yes, there is a royal sage named Indradhyumna. His virtue being diminished, he fell from heaven crying "my achievements are lost.” He came to me and asked, “Do you know me?"

sa: जनक उवाच ममानुषी दिव्यरूपोऽसि साक्षात्। अजैषीर्यद् बन्दिनं त्वं विवादे निसृष्ट एष तव कामोऽद्य बन्दी॥
en: Janaka said: I listen to your words which are excellent and superhuman. Your appearance also appears to me as superhuman. As you "have to day defeated Bandi, I place even him at your disposal.

sa: लेलिहानैर्महानागैः कृतचीरममित्रहन्। विभीस्ततस्तदस्त्रं तु घोरं रौद्रं सनातनम्॥
en: (And) O destroyer of foes, as for his clothing he wore huge serpents issuing out their tongues.

sa: ततः परावसुर्दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरं समुपस्थितम्। बृहद्युम्नमुवाचेदं वचनं हषगद्गदम्॥
en: Thereupon having seen his brother come back again, Paravasu spoke these words, his voice choked with delight.

sa: एवमेतं त्वतिक्रम्य महामेरुमतन्द्रितः। भावयन् सर्वभूतानि पुनर्गच्छति मन्दरम्॥
en: Thus crossing the Mahameru unerringly and nourishing all the creatures (the moon) goes back to the Mandara.

sa: अर्थेन तु समो नार्थो यत्र लभ्येत नोदयः। न तत्र विपणः कार्यः खरकण्डूयनं हि तत्॥
en: But where wealth is more than sufficient, there should be no expenditure of wealth. In such cases investment of wealth is like the scratching of an ass, which is first pleasurable and then painful.

sa: दत्त्वा यस्त्वतिथिभ्यो वै भुङ्क्ते तेनैव नित्यशः। यावतो ह्यन्धसः पिण्डानश्नाति सततं द्विजः॥ तावतां गोसहस्राणां फलं प्राप्नोति दायकः। यदेनो यौवनकृतं तत् सर्वं नश्यतेध्रुवम्॥
en: Than that food which such a person takes after having fed the guests with its first portion. Each mouthful that the Brahmana eats after having fed the guests produces the fruit of giving away one thousand kine. Whatever sins might have been committed by him in his childhood are all destroyed.

sa: एवमाशीः प्रयुक्ता हि दक्षेण यजता पुरा। इह ये वै मरिष्यन्ति ते वै स्वर्गजितो नराः॥
en: A blessing was pronounced here by Daksha when in the days of yore he was performing sacrifice at this spot. (It was as follows), “The men that will die here will go to heaven.”

sa: इन्द्र उवाच उभावेतौ न सोमा) नासत्याविति मे मतिः। भिषजौ दिवि देवानां कर्मणा तेन नार्हतः॥
en: Indra said: These two (Ashvins) in my opinion have no right to receive an offering of the Soma juice; they are the physicians to the celestials. As such, they are prevented (from receiving it).

sa: अथोपविष्टं राजानं भ्रातृभिः परिवारितम्। उवाच भगवान् व्यासस्तत्तद्वाक्यविशारदः॥
en: When the king was seated surrounded by his brothers, the illustrious Vyasa, the skillful speaker, thus spoke.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच प्राप्तौ स्व यज्ञं नृप संदिद्दसू कौतूहलं नौ बलवन्नरेन्द्र। प्राप्ताविहावामतिथी प्रवेशं काक्षावहे द्वारपतेस्तवाज्ञाम्॥
en: Ashtavakra said : O king, O ruler of men, we have come to see the sacrifice, our curiosity was very great. We have come as Athithis (guests). We ask your order on the gate-keeper.

sa: एकं हि मे सायकं चित्ररूपं दिग्धं विषेणाहर संगृहीतम्। येन विद्धो वामदेवः शयीत संदश्यमानः श्वभिरार्तरूपः॥
en: Bring me one of those beautiful but poisonous arrows that are kept with you, so that pierced by it, Vamadeva may lie prostrate on the ground in pain and be torn by the dogs.

sa: प्रमूढोऽभूत् प्रजासर्गे तपस्तेपे महत् ततः। तपसा महता युक्तः सोऽथ उरष्टुं प्रचक्रमे॥ सर्वाः प्रजा मनुः साक्षाद् यथावद् भरतर्षभ। इत्येतन्मात्स्यकं नाम पुराणं परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: In this work of creation, illusion overtook him: he therefore performed great asceticism, Having obtained ascetic success, O best of the Bharata race, Manu again took up the work of creation in proper and exact order. I have thus narrated to you the old story called the Legend of the Fish.

sa: ततो वायुर्महाशीघ्रो नीचैः शर्करकर्षणः। प्रादुरासीद् खरस्पर्शः संग्राममभिचोदयन्॥
en: Then rose suddenly a high and violent wind, piercing to the touch and blowing gravels and stones.

sa: लोमश उवाच एतावदुक्त्वा विरराम बन्दी। श्लोकस्यार्धं व्याजहाराष्टवक्रः।
en: Lomasha said : Having said this Bandi stopped. Thereupon Ashtavakra supplied the other half of the Sloka.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच बन्धिष्ये सेतुना गङ्गां सुखः पन्था भविष्यति। क्लिश्यते हि जनस्तात तरमाणः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Indra said: O sire, I am trying to bridge the Ganga, so that a comfortable way may be made across it. People meet with great inconvenience in again and again crossing and recrossing it.

sa: न चापि पाद्यं बहु मन्यतेऽसौ फलानि चेमानि मयाऽऽहतानि। एवंव्रतोऽस्मीति च मामवोचत् फलानि चान्यानि समाददन्मे।॥
en: He did not care for water to wash his feet or for fruits offered by me to him. He told me such was the religious observance practised by him. He gave me other fruits.

sa: विकरण उवाच याज्ञसेन्या यदुक्तं तद् वाक्यं विबूत पार्थिवाः। अविवेकेन वाक्यस्य नरकः सद्य एव नः॥
en: Vikarna said O kings, answer the question that has been asked by Yajnaseni (Draupadi). If we do not decide a matter referred to us, we shall certainly have to go to hell without delay.

sa: सव्ये पाणौ गृहीत्वा तु याजकोऽपि स्म कर्षति। कुररीणामिवार्तानां समाकृष्य तु तं सुतम्॥ विशस्य चैनं विधिवद् वपामस्य जुहाव सः। वपायां हूयमानायां गन्धमाघ्राय मातरः॥ आर्ता निपेतुः सहसा पृथिव्यां कुरुनन्दन। सर्वाश्च गर्भानलभंस्ततस्ताः परमाङ्गनाः॥
en: But the Ritvija held the boy by the right hand and pulled him. Like female ospreys they screamed in agony. But the priest dragged the boy, killed him and in due form made an offering of his fat. O descendant of Kuru, while the fat was made an offering (to the sacrificial fire) the, aggrieved mothers smelt its smell and they all suddenly fell on the ground. Then all those beautiful women conceived.

sa: रहश्च केचिद् वार्ष्णेयं प्रशशंसुर्नराधिपाः। केचिदेव सुसंरब्धा मध्यस्थास्त्वपरेऽभवन्॥
en: Some kings praised the Vrishni hero in private, some became exited with anger, while others became mediators.

sa: शकटापणवेशाश्च वणिजो वन्दिनस्तथा। नराश्च मृगयाशीलाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Carriages, shops, pavilions, traders, bards and men, trained in hunting, by hundred and thousands, followed the king.

sa: ईदृशो न हि राजेन्द्र धर्मः क्वचन दृश्यते। प्रजानां पालने यो वै पुरा राजर्षिभिः कृतः॥
en: O king of kings, such a (great) merit is not seen in anything else as it is seen in the protection of men as done by the royal sages in the days of yore.

sa: पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतश्चास्य सर्वे वानरयूथपाः। अनुजग्मुर्महाशैलान्विविधांश्च वनस्पतीन् ॥
en: And followed him on all sides the leaders of the monkeys with huge crags and various trees.

sa: रजन्यामप्रशस्तश्च संतापयति चन्द्रमाः। कृष्णरक्तांशुपर्यन्तो यथा लोकस्य संक्षये॥
en: At night, the ominous Moon with a black-red brim as at the time of universal wreck, burn.

sa: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा जाम्बवान्वाक्यमब्रवीत्। शृणु नैर्ऋतशार्दूल यस्मात्पृच्छामि मारुतिम्॥
en: Hearing Vibhisana's words, Jambavan said, "Hear, O foremost of Raksasas, why I enquire after the wind-god's son.

sa: प्रजगुर्देवगन्धर्वा ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः।७१।। अभिषेके तदहस्य तदा रामस्य धीमतः।
en: The intelligent and worthy Rāma being installed the celestials and the Gandharvas sang and the Apsaras danced.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धाः सर्वे सुरगणास्तदा। रावणं विमुखीकृत्य शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्॥
en: In the meantime, the celestials, all enraged, covered Rāvana with a downpour of shafts and belaboured him.

sa: अब्रवीत्तु तदा रामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्। वह वैश्रवणं देवमनुजानामि गम्यताम्॥
en: Thereupon Rāma said to the excellent car, Do you (now) go to Vaisravana, I do permit you.

sa: श्रुत्वा हनूमतो वाक्यं यथावदनुपूर्वशः। ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: Hearing Hanumăn's speech duly from the beginning, the exceedingly energetic Rāma having truth for this prowess, said.

sa: ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतोऽथ निपपाताग्रतः प्रभोः। ततः परमसंभ्रान्तो रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Stricken with the of Brahma, Kumbhakarma fell down before the Lord. Then, "extremely agitated, Ravana said. curse

sa: नरान्तकः क्रोधवशं जगाम हतं तुरंगं पतितं समीक्ष्य। स मुष्टिमुद्यम्य महाप्रभावो जघान शीर्षे युधि वालिपुत्रम्॥
en: Narāntaka seeing his charger slain and fallen, was seized with a furious wrath, and raising his clenched fist, that one endowed with exceeding great energy in that conflict hit Vāll's son on the head.

sa: एकवेणी अधःशय्या ध्यानं मलिनमम्बरम्। अस्थानेऽप्युपवासश्च नैतान्यौपयिकानि ते॥
en: A single lock of hair, to lie down on earth and useless fast-these do not become you.

sa: सुवेलं साधुशैलेन्द्रमिमं धातुशतैश्चितम्। अध्यारोहामहे सर्वे वत्स्यामोऽत्र निशामिमाम्॥
en: We shall all ascend this mount Suvela, be dight with metals; and pass this night even here.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेहीं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। क्रोधसंरम्भसंयुक्तः सीतामुत्तरमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having spoken thus to Vaidehi, Ravana, the lord of Raksasas, having his wrath subdued, again bespake Sītā.

sa: विकीर्णैः पर्वताकारे रक्षोभिरभिमार्दितैः।। आसीद्वसुमती पूर्णा तदा युद्धमदान्वितैः॥
en: The field was blocked up with scattered mountain-like Rākşasas influenced by martial ardour, mangled by their enemies.

sa: सोऽभिगम्य महात्मानं राघवं शोकलालसम्। वानरांश्चापि ददृशे वाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणान्॥
en: And approaching the high-souled Rāghava, overwhelmed with grief, he saw the monkeys with tears in their eyes.

sa: राक्षस्यो दारुणकथा वरमेतत्प्रयच्छ मे। मुष्टिभिः पाणिघातैश्च विशालैश्चैव बाहुभिः॥ जङ्घाजानुप्रहारैश्च दन्तानां चैव पीडनैः। भक्षणैः कर्णनासानां केशानां लुञ्चनैस्तथा॥ निपात्य हन्तुमिच्छामि तव विप्रियकारिणीः। एवं प्रहारैर्बहुभिः संप्रहार्य यशस्विनी॥ घातये तीव्ररूपाभिर्याभिस्त्वं तर्जिता पुरा।
en: I wish to slay all these she-demons, who had used harsh words and had always offended you, stricking them with fists, fingers, arms, dreadful knee-joints, teeth, chopping off their ears and noses, and pulling them by their hairs; do you confer upon me this permission. O far famed lady, I shall slay them by these various means, by whom dreadful as they are, you had been distressed before.

sa: तस्य निष्पततस्तूर्णं कुम्भकर्णस्य धीमतः। बभूवुर्घोररूपाणि निमित्तानि समन्ततः॥
en: As the intelligent Kumbhakarņa sallied out speedily, dreadful were the omens that presented themselves on all sides.

sa: किं मां न प्रेक्षसे राजन्कि वा न प्रतिभाषसे। बालां बालेन संप्राप्तां भायां मां सहचारिणीम्॥
en: O king, why do you not look at me? And why is it that you do not answer me, who am a girl, hardly arrived at youth, and who am your wife and companion?

sa: केषांचिदिषुभिर्बाहूंश्चिच्छेदाथ स राक्षसः॥ वानराणां सुसंरब्धः पार्श्व केषांचिदाक्षिपत्।
en: He cut off, with his arrows, the arms of some and some were deprived of their sides.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः। ततो रामं यथातत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Being thus addressed by Vaidehi, Hanuman, the Wind-god's son, began to give an exact description of Rāma.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः। विमानं सूर्यसंकाशमाजुहाव त्वरान्वितः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, Vibhīşaņa the lord of Rākşasas, speedily brought the car resembling the Sun.

sa: ततो रामाभ्यनुज्ञातं तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्। हंसयुक्तं महावेगं निपपात महीतलम्॥
en: Commanded by Rāma that excellent car drawn by ganders got down on the earth with great velocity.

sa: इत्येवं मतिमास्थाय बाली मौनमुपास्थितः। जपन्वै नैगमान्मन्त्रांस्तस्थौ पर्वतराडिव॥
en: Having thought thus Vāli remained silent for sometime and reciting incantations he waited there like a mountain.

sa: आत्मानमुपमां कृत्वा स्वेषु दारेषु रम्यताम्। अतुष्टं स्वेषु दारेषु चपलं चपलेन्द्रियम्। नयन्ति निकृतिप्रज्ञं परदाराः पराभवम्॥
en: Making an example of you, do you enjoy with your own wives. Forsooth those vicious-minded, those of agitated senses, who are not satisfied with their own wives, are brought to misery by others' wives.

sa: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम्। अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः॥
en: Hearing Vaidehi's speech pathetic and uttered with tears, the highly energetic Hanumān, son to the Wind-god, said.

sa: सर्वदा सर्वभूतानां नास्ति मृत्युरलक्षणः। तव तद्वदयं मृत्युमैथिलीकृतलक्षणः॥
en: Death does not always visit all men without any cause-and Maithili is the cause of the death.

sa: आधावमानं मुसलं कार्तवीर्यस्तदार्जुनः। निपुणं वञ्चयामास गदया गतविक्लवः॥
en: Not the least agitated on beholding that mace, the king Arjuna, by his club, baffled its action.

sa: राघवश्चापि धर्मात्मा प्राप्य राज्यमनुत्तमम्। ईजे बहुविधैर्यज्ञैः ससुतभ्रातृबान्धवः॥
en: Obtaining that excellent kingdom, the virtuous souled Raghava performed many sacrifices with his sons, brothers and friends.

sa: स बाणवर्षं तु ववर्ष तीवं रामानुजः कार्मुकसंप्रयुक्तम्। क्षुरार्धचन्द्रोत्तमकर्णभल्लैः शरांश्च चिच्छेद न चुक्षुभे च ॥
en: Rāma's younger brother poured showers of arrows from his bow; and, planting himself at his post, cut off those arrows (of his adversary) by means of .razors, and crescents, and excellent karnas and darts.

sa: प्रजापतिं सुराः सर्वे वाक्यं प्राञ्जलयोऽब्रुवन्। न तावत्कुम्भकर्णाय प्रदातव्यो वरस्त्वया॥ जानीषे हि यथा लोकांस्त्रासयत्येष दुर्मतिः।
en: Thereat the celestials in a body represented to the lord of creatures with joined hands. 'On Kumbhakarņa you should confer no boons, since you know in what manner does this wickedminded one frighten people.

sa: सा सीता तच्छिरो दृष्ट्वा तच्च कार्मुकमुत्तमम्। सुग्रीवप्रतिसंसर्गमाख्यातं च हनूमता॥ नयने मुखवर्णं च भर्तुस्तत्सदृशं मुखम्। केशान्केशान्तदेशं च तं च चूडामणिं शुभम्॥ एतैः सर्वैरभिज्ञानैरभिज्ञाय सुदुःखिता। विजगहेऽत्र कैकेयों क्रोशन्ती कुररी यथा॥
en: Seeing that head and that excellent bow, and (remembering) the union of (Rama) and Sugriva related by Hanumãn, and (seeing) those eyes, and the complexion of that face, and that countenance like to that of her lord, and that hair and that forehead; and that beautiful jewel forming the crest; and recognizing (Rāma) by all these tokens combined, (Sītā), exceedingly aggrieved, rebuked Kaikeyī, lamenting like a female osprey.

sa: अनन्यदेवत्वमियं क्षमा च भूमौ च शय्या नियमश्च धर्मे। पतिव्रतात्वं विफलं ममेदं कृतं कृतघ्नेष्विव मानुषाणाम्॥
en: Alas! this my devotedness to my husband, my forgiveness, my lying down on the bare earth, my observance of religious vows, my wife-like virtues, are lost like to service done for an ungrateful wight.

sa: 'स तु तां वीक्ष्य सुश्रोणी पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्॥ अब्रवीत्परमोदारो दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा। भद्रे कस्यासि दुहिता कुतो वा त्वमिहागता। किं कार्य कस्य वा हेतोस्तत्त्वतो ब्रूहि शोभने ।।१८
en: Seeing that one of the shapely hips, having a face fair as the full Moon, (that exceedingly high-minded ascetic) flaming in energy accosted her thus. O gentle one, whose daughter are you? And when do you come hither? And what is your errand? And for whom (do you come)? O beauteous (damsel), truly tell me this.

sa: ततस्तान्पूजितान्दृष्ट्वा रत्नाथैहरियूथपान्। आरुरोह तदा रामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्॥ अङ्केनादाय वैदेही लज्जमानां मनस्विनीम्। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विक्रान्तेन धनुष्मता॥
en: Beholding all those leading monkeys worshipped with jewels and riches Rāma ascended that excellent car, taking the bashful, and high-minded Vaidehi on his lap and accompanied by his powerful brother Laksmana, a skilled bowman.

sa: स शक्तिमाशक्तिसमाहतः सन् जज्वाल भूमौ स रघुप्रवीरः। तं विह्वलन्तं सहसाभ्युपेत्य जग्राह राजा तरसा भुजाभ्याम्॥
en: Smite with the dart, that hero of the Raghu race, although possessed of strength, was aglow. And the king at once with his arms seized that one, who had been deprived of his senses.

sa: अद्य शूलनिपातैश्च वानराणां महाचमूम्। प्रदहिष्यामि संप्राप्तां शुष्कन्धनमिवानलः॥
en: Like to fire consuming dry fuel, shall I today slay the host of monkeys with my darts.

sa: रथमादित्यसंकाशं युक्तं परमवाजिभिः। आस्थाय त्रिशिरा वीरो वालिपुत्रमथाभ्यगात्॥
en: Ascending a car resembling the Sun yoked with superb steeds, the heroic Triģiras rushed against Vali's son.

sa: देवान्तकश्च संक्रुद्धः परिघेण तदाङ्गदम्। उपगम्याभिहत्याशु व्यपचक्राम वेगवान्॥
en: Devantaka, enraged advancing, hit Angada with his bludgeon, and then, endowed with velocity, he swiftly turned away.

sa: राक्षसं क्रूरकर्माणं विद्युज्जिद्धं समानय। येन तद्राघवशिरः संग्रामात्स्वयमाहृतम्॥
en: Bring (hither) the Raksasa, Vidyujjibha of cruel deeds, who has personally brought Rāghava's head from the field.

sa: वानरैश्चापि संक्रुद्धे राक्षसौघाः समन्ततः। पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च संपिष्टा वसुधातले॥
en: Numbers of Rākşasas all around were beaten to the ground by infuriated monkeys with trees and mountain-peaks.

sa: ततः शत्रुघ्नवचनात्सुमन्त्रो नाम सारथिः। योजयित्वाभिचक्राम रथं सर्वाङ्गशोभनम्॥
en: Thereupon at the words of ſatrughna, the charioteer by name Sumantra got ready the perfectly beautiful car.

sa: ततः कोपपरीतात्मा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। निर्याणं सर्वसैन्यानां द्रुतमाज्ञापयत्तदा॥
en: Then, his soul wrought up with wrath, Rāvaņa-lord of Rākşasas-speedily ordered the whole host to sally out.

sa: नरान्तकः कुम्भहनुर्महानादः समुन्नतः। एते प्रहस्तसचिवाः सर्वे जघ्नुर्वनौकसः॥
en: Narāntaka and Kambhahanu and Mahānand and Samunnata-all counsellors of Prahasta-set about slaughtering the rangers of the woods.

sa: अङ्गदस्य प्रहर्षाच्च जानामि शुभदर्शन ॥ न मत्सकाशमागच्छेत् कृत्ये हि विनिपातिते। युवराजो महाबाहुः प्लवतामङ्गदो वरः॥
en: I (further more) infer this from Angada's joy, O you of auspicious presence. Without being successful in his mission, the large-armed prince, Angada, the foremost of the monkeys, would not have come to me.

sa: हनूमान्पुरतस्तेषां जगाम कपिकुञ्जरः। प्रगृह्य सुमहच्छ्रङ्ग पर्वतस्य दुरासदम्।।।।
en: And preceded them all, Hanuman, the foremost of the monkeys, with a huge mountaintop in his hand.

sa: उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन। नरके नियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम॥
en: We have heard, O Janardana, that those whose family-rites are thus destroyed, live for ever in hell.

sa: तदा स्म दानवा देवाशरसंस्पर्शकोविदान्। निजघ्नुः शस्त्रविदुषश्छादयन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: Then the Dänavas, enveloping themselves, momentarily destroyed the deities, albeit versed in arms and accomplished in weapons.

sa: दशग्रीवो महाबाहुरुक्तवान्मम संनिधौ। मया निर्भर्त्सतश्चासीद्बहुशोक्तः सुदुर्मतिः॥ स क्रोधेन मया चोक्तो ध्वंससे च पुनः पुनः।
en: The mighty-armed Ten-necked one had (once); spoken in my presence (to that effect). Thereat I greatly rebuked that wicked-minded one; and I said again and again in anger, You disregard (your religion and honour).

sa: निरस्यमानो रामस्तु दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा॥ नाशक्नोदभिसंधातुं सायकारणमूर्धनि ।
en: Rāma reduced to sore straits by the Tennecked Rākṣasa, could not discharge his arrows in the conflict.

sa: तान्यञ्जलिसहस्राणि प्रगृहीतानि नागरैः। व्याकोशानीव पद्मानि ददर्श भरताग्रजः॥
en: The elder brother of Bharata observed the folded hands of the citizens like so many blown lotuses.

sa: ततः सीतां समस्तास्ता राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः। परुषं परुषानर्हामूचुस्तद्वाक्यमप्रियम्॥
en: Thereupon all those Rākşasīs, having terrible faces again and again pursued Sitä with reproaches rough and rude.

sa: किंनरा मदनेनार्ता रक्ता मधुरकण्ठिनः। समं संप्रजगुर्यत्र मनस्तुष्टिविवर्धनम्॥
en: There sang the Kinnaras, possessed by desire, and having sweet voice, enhancing the delight of the mind.

sa: पीडितां दुःखसंतप्तां परिक्षीणां तपस्विनीम्। ग्रहेणाङ्गारकेणेव पीडितामिव रोहिणीम्॥
en: Oppressed, racked with grief, weakened and chaste as she was, she appeared like Rohini possessed by Ketu.

sa: सोऽपश्यत्स महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवस्ततस्ततः। प्राणिनः सुकृतं चैव भुञ्जानांश्चैव दुष्कृतम्॥
en: The mighty-armed ten-necked one all around saw creatures reaping the consequences of their fair and foul acts.

sa: विनिपात्य च यक्षौघान्विक्षोभ्य विनिगृह्य च। त्वया कैलासशिखराद्विमानमिदमाहृतम्॥
en: Discomfiting and slaying the band of Yaksas, you did bring this flowery car from the mount Kailasa.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। अमर्षवशमापन्नो राघवं समुदैक्षत॥
en: Being thus addressed by Vaidehī, Lakşmaņa, the slayer of enemies, being possessed by anger, looked towards Rāghava.

sa: स राज्यमखिलं शासनिहतारिमहायशाः। राघवः परमोदारः : शशास परया मुदा।। उवाच लक्ष्मणं रामो धर्मज्ञं धर्मवत्सलः॥
en: Having slain his foes, the highly generous and glorious Rama, ruled in great delight, the kingdom extending all over the earth. And Rama, fond of the pious, spoke to Laksmana, conversant with piety, saying-

sa: कृतास्मि विधवा राजंस्त्वया बलवता बलात्। एते राजंस्त्वया वीयर्यादैत्या विनिहता रणे॥ कालकेया इति ख्याताः सहस्राणि चतुर्दशः। प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयान्मे तत्र भर्ता महाबलः॥ सोपि त्वया हतस्तात रिपुणा भ्रातृगन्धिना। त्वयास्मि निहता राजस्वयमेव हि बन्धुना॥
en: “O king, by you, powerful as you are, I have forcibly been made widow." Fourteen a thousand demons, under the name of Kälakeyas, have been destroyed by you, O King, in the battle and among them was my highly powerful husband, dearer than my life. He has been slain by you, O dear one, an enemy, a brother only in name. I have been killed by you, O king, who are my brother.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम पुलस्त्यतनयो द्विजः। अग्निहोत्रमुपातिष्ठच्चतुर्थ इव पावकः॥
en: In the meanwhile, O Rama, that twice-born one-Pulastya's was performing the Agnihotra, like the fourth Fire itself.

sa: ततस्त्रिजटया सार्धं पुष्पकादवरुह्य सा। अशोकवनिकामेव राक्षसीभिः प्रवेशिता॥
en: Then in company with Trijatā alighting from Puşpaka, she along with the Rākşasis entered the asoka wood.

sa: किं नु वक्ष्यामि कौसल्यां मातरं किं नु कैकयीम्। कथमम्बां सुमित्रां च पुत्रदर्शनलालसाम्॥ विवत्सां वेपमानां च वेपन्ती कुररीमिव। कथमाश्वासयिष्यामि यदि यास्यामि तं विना ॥
en: What shall I say to Kausalyā; and what shall I say to Kaikeyi ? And what shall I say to mother Sumitrā eager for a sight of her son? And if I go (back) without him, how shall I soothe her, like to a cow reft of her calf; and trembling; and resembling a mourning Kurari?

sa: चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं तु वानरांस्तानुवाच ह। हनुमत्प्रमुखान्सर्वानिदं वचनमुत्तमम्॥
en: And meditating for a while, he spoke to the monkeys headed by Hanuman the following excellent words.

sa: निवेदयत मां क्षिप्रं राघवाय महात्मने। सर्वलोकशरण्याय विभीषणमुपस्थितम्॥
en: Do you soon mention to the high-souled Rāghava, the refuge of all creatures, that Vibhīşaņa has arrived.

sa: प्रहस्य च महानादमुक्तोऽहं भीमया तया। अवस्थितमसम्भ्रान्तमिदं वाक्यमशोभनम्॥
en: And laughing (scornfully), that grim one said these inauspicious words to me, who was inert, although undaunted,

sa: ततो दृष्टः पुमांस्तत्र हृष्टो हासं मुमोच सः। श्रुत्वा स तु महाहासमूर्ध्वरोमाभवत्तदा॥ ज्वालामध्ये स्थितस्तत्र हेममाली विमोहितः। आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्ष्यः साक्षादिव यमः स्थितः॥
en: There was a man in that flame, who, when seen, laughed aloud. Hearing that dreadful laughter Prahasta's down stood on their end. There was another man in that flame, as if in a swoon, engarlanded with golden lotuses, incapable of being looked at, like the sun, and resembling the Yama's self.

sa: तदा गदाभिर्गुर्वीभिः प्रासैः खङ्गैः परश्वधैः। निर्जघ्नुर्वानरान्घोराराक्षसाः पर्वतोपमाः॥
en: The Rákşasas resembling mountains, with huge clubs, prasas, daggers and Parasvādhas, struck the monkeys (in their turn).

sa: यो वज्रपाताशनिसंनिपातान् न चुक्षुभे नापि चचाल राजा। स रामबानाभिहतो भृशार्तश्चचाल चापं च मुमोच वीरः॥
en: That the king hero-who had not smarted nor shaken under the impetus of Vajra and the thunder-bolt, assailed with the arrows of Răma and agonised in consequence, shock and lost hold of his bow.

sa: एतानौत्पातिकान्दृष्ट्वा वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाबलः। धैर्यमालम्ब्य तेजस्वी निर्जगाम रणोत्सुकः॥
en: Witnessing these evil omens, the exceedingly powerful and energetic Vajradanșțra, assuming patience, set out, eager for encounter.

sa: रावणोत्सादनार्थानि रामप्रीतिकराणि च। रोमहर्षकराण्येव कर्ता कर्माणि संयुगे॥
en: In the war he will kill do such bewildering deeds as will destroy Råvana and please Rāma.

sa: विक्रान्तस्यार्यशीलस्य संयुगेष्वनिवर्तिनः। स्नुषा दशरथस्सैषा ज्येष्ठा राज्ञो यशस्विनी॥
en: She is the well-known eldest daughter-in-law of the king Dasaratha, of an adorable character and unchecked prowess.

sa: संनिवार्य परानीकमब्रवीत्तान्वनौकसः। हनूमान्संनिवर्तध्वं न नः साध्यमिदं बलम्॥
en: Obstructing the Rākṣasas (for some time) Hanumān spoke to monkeys, saying, “Stay, we should not fight now.
